row.name: Doors
row.detailed_description: Doors is a first person linear puzzle game where you open doors by solving puzzles involving clones. There different doors with unique mechanics. Manipulating clones will be your bread and butter, swapping with them, destroying them, stacking them. Anti-Clone zones will destroy your clones. Anti-Player zones will destroy you, Anti-Swap zones prevent swapping.  This is a short indie game developed by one person with a singular vision. I hope you enjoy it.
row.short_description: Doors is a short 3D sci-fi puzzle game. You and your army of clones move in unison to escape the labyrinth one puzzle at a time. Flip levers, open doors, reach high places, see from new perspectives, create clones, swap with them and destroy them to solve puzzles in a desolate landscape.

row.name: Passion Rift
row.detailed_description: In the year 2035, you're not a soldier, explorer, or hero — you're entertainment.  Passion Rift  drops you into the world’s biggest reality show, where fantasy races, corporate conspiracies, and interdimensional horrors collide — along with temptation, rivalry, and desire. A mysterious portal has opened on a tropical island in the Seychelles. Bought for billions and transformed into a luxury resort and broadcast hub, the island is now the heart of Passion Rift  — a deadly show where participants venture into alien dimensions searching for fame, treasure, thrills… and maybe a little pleasure. Thousands of years ago, the portal first touched our world, merging realms and races. Now elves take selfies, goblins shop online, and orcs argue on forums. But stepping through the Rift still means danger, glory... and cameras rolling — even when the lights go down. Every step is filmed. Every decision has a cost   Reality show survival  – compete, progress, and become a global star… or die trying.   Explore alien worlds  – dangerous dimensions filled with monsters, tech, and secrets.   Character progression  – unlock skills, gear, perks, and rise to global fame.   Idle combat  – assemble your squad and let them battle through waves of enemies using unique skills and synergies.   Flirt system  – build bonds, unlock dialogues, and collect sexy outfits for each girl. Corporate intrigue  – uncover the dark truth behind the portal and the show's creators. Over 18 girls from all over the world — and from wildly different fantasy races — have joined the show alongside you. Elves, goblins, orcs, mutants and more, each with unique looks, outfits, and personalities — from shy to dominant, sweet to chaotic. Form bonds through choices, gifts, and flirty banter. Unlock private scenes and stylish and revealing outfits. Some might want your heart. Others just want a taste of the spotlight — or you. Your relationships might just help you survive… or complicate everything. Will they fall for your charm — or leave you behind?
row.short_description: Enter a futuristic reality show where you seduce exotic beings, battle interdimensional monsters, and uncover dark corporate secrets. Build your team, chase desire, and become a star on screen... and behind the scenes.

row.name: Ex vs Ex
row.detailed_description: En un tiempo pasado, compartían todo: poder, territorios, lacayos y hasta una íntima cueva con vista a su reino conquistado para el verano. Ella, una poderosa hechicera muy temida en todos los planos astrales y líneas temporales, capaz de invocar orbes oscuros y convertir a quien la contradiga en cenizas. Él, un guerrero legendario, conquistador de reinos que jamás tuvo que limpiar sus armaduras o usar una espada sin filo. ¿Podría ser más obvio? Fueron parejas, aliados y los héroes más formidables del siglo. Pero lastimosamente esta historia de amor no es eterna y llegaron los desacuerdos. Que si el trono tenía que estar más a la izquierda, que si él era más fuerte en el campo de batalla o que si ella logró más victorias, lo típico. Este conflicto bélico fue escalando y, al no haber contrato prenupcial, no quedó otra alternativa: dividir el territorio a gritos de guerra, espadas y hechizos.  Ahora, en este juego de estrategia por turnos, dos jugadores tomarán el lugar de esta ex-pareja heroica para quedarse con el territorio del reino pero sobre todo, demostrar quién tiene razón. El campo de batalla es tan grande como su sed de quedarse con todo y, con cada hechizo y ataque, demostrarán quién es el verdadero dueño del sillón del trono. Porque cuando el amor se acaba, el tablero se arma. Características principales Juego PvP local o en línea: jugá contra otro jugador en red local, en la misma pantalla o en línea a través de Steam. Emparejamiento automático en línea: al jugar online, el sistema te emparejará automáticamente con otro jugador disponible. Héroes con estilos de combate únicos: elegí entre dos personajes. La Hechicera domina la magia oscura e invoca orbes para causar daño en cadena, mientras que el Guerrero posee un dominio implacable de la espada, tené cuidado si logra acercarse. Batallas por turnos en un tablero táctico: mové a tus personajes durante tu turno y usá sus habilidades para conquistar bienes o derrotar al enemigo. Sistema de puntos de acción y movimiento: cada turno disponés de puntos de movimiento para desplazarte y puntos de acción para ejecutar habilidades. Bienes a conquistar: combatí para adueñarte de los bienes del mapa. Cada conquista o interacción otorga beneficios estratégicos que pueden inclinar la balanza a tu favor.
row.short_description: Se divorcia la pareja más importante del reino, ¿quién ganará el juicio de división de bienes? En este juego PvP por turnos, representá a la hechicera que usa la distancia e invoca con su magia esferas de poder para hacer daño, o representá al guerrero que con su fuerza destruye todo a su paso.

row.name: Gemstone Realm
row.detailed_description: Gemstone Realm is a game that uses a triple play mechanism. In the game, players will play as a hero, exploring mysterious worlds and randomly opening portals. Each portal will form a secret realm, where there will be some dangerous monsters and a large number of gems scattered on the ground. Heroes keep coming to fight monsters. We need to be aware that these gems will help us in battle. If the gems are linked together by three, they can have different effects, causing damage and healing wounds. By successfully hunting these monsters, we will obtain various gems that can help heroes grow.
row.short_description: Explore unknown secret caves, successfully hunt monsters inside, and obtain various mysterious power hungry gems. These angry gems not only help us grow, but also have the opportunity to be exchanged for US dollars and fiat currency. Endless Adventure and Wealth - All in the Secret Gem Realm

row.name: Pair Master
row.detailed_description: This is a multiplayer tile-matching game. The gameplay is very simple. Players need to flip over two identical cards to eliminate them. Remembering the card patterns will help you complete the game faster. The game offers both single-player and multiplayer modes. In multiplayer mode, there are different game variations to choose from. For example, both players may have an identical deck arranged in the same order, racing to see who finishes first. Alternatively, players can compete on the same set of cards, with the winner determined by points. You can also practice in single-player mode to improve your speed and memory.
row.short_description: A challenging matching game that requires quick reflexes and memory skills. It includes both single-player and multiplayer modes, with various difficulty levels and objectives to choose from in competitive play.

row.name: Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 - Journey to Tuonela
row.detailed_description: Journey to Tuonela Embark on a dark and mysterious adventure which takes players on a journey through Finnish mythology and the mysteries of Tuonela. John, a father who has experienced a tragic loss, encounters a supernatural entity that wants to make a deal with him. This entity needs John's help to gain access to Tuonela, where there are disturbing disturbances in the movement of souls. Only the soul of a grieving living person can help the entity find answers and restore balance between the realms. Players guide John through the adventure in Tuonela, encountering characters from Finnish mythology and other mythological creatures. Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 is a thrilling and intriguing story adventure that tells a fictional tale of Finnish mythology. Are you ready to face the forces of darkness and uncover what lies in the depths of Tuonela? Blending AI Art with Uppbeat’s Immersive Sounds The game's visuals and character voices are created using AI technology, while the music and sound effects are from Uppbeat, creating an energetic and engaging atmosphere in the game. Welcome to experience this gaming adventure! A Solo Developer's Creation This game is a solo creation by SoulTradeStudios. Design, programming, and overall implementation are the work of a single developer. Thank you for supporting an independent studio and enjoying this unique gaming experience! Estimated Playtime The estimated playtime is about 1.5 to 2 hours if all dialogues are listened to. Gameplay Style Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 is a narrative-driven adventure where gameplay is minimal, focusing primarily on following the story and interacting with its characters. While the game offers more to watch and listen to than traditional gameplay mechanics, there are small puzzles to solve along the way.
row.short_description: Point-and-click adventure featuring eerie scenes
row.notes: This game contains alcohol consumption, violence, and strong language. There are scenes where the main character drinks alcohol and fights monstrous creatures with a rifle, resulting in blood effects. Some profanity appears in the dialogue. The game also includes disturbing imagery of tormented souls in Tuonela.

row.name: In The Foundations
row.detailed_description: Echoing themes from Hereditary, The Ritual, and Layers of Fear, In The Foundations is a horror visual novel that centers around family, loss, generational debt, and duty . You didn't want to go home ever again. You're Taylor. Your dad died suddenly a few weeks ago. It looks like he left you the family house. Really though, you swore you'd never come back here. Nothing specific bad ever happened, but the place makes you feel sick to your stomach. Like you're some how allergic. You know it's up to you to at least clean the place out. Your dad and stepmom had been divorced for years, and you've never been close with your half sister, Paige. Fortunately, you get to do this alone, at your own pace. But are you really the only one in the house? As you start the process though, that same feeling from your childhood is still there. But there's more... a presence, maybe? It shifts from terrifying to comforting. And it all seems to circle around the basement that your dad never let you enter. You need to find out what's down there. You need to understand what is in the house with you. And you need to open this lockbox that your dad left behind. Features: 24k+ words 1-2 hours of gameplay a combination lock puzzle 7 distinct endings depending on player choice snow globe Additional Steam Features: music room for tracks that unlocks after beating the game once a mini-crossword that unlocks after each ending (3 5x5 crosswords, 1 6x6 crossword, 3 7x7 crosswords)
row.short_description: A horror visual novel about coming back to your childhood home.
row.notes: In The Foundations has horror theming and as such does touch on dark topics such as captivity, shared family trauma, and death.

row.name: The Cursed Deep
row.detailed_description: Embark on a High-Seas Adventure with 'The Cursed Deep' An enthralling virtual reality game that casts you as the defender of your own pirate ship navigating through mysterious, treacherous waters. Your mission: **fend off the mythical beasts that rise from the ocean's depths with only your wits and your cannons.** VR Experience In this immersive VR experience, you'll feel the salt spray and the thrill of battle as you stand on the deck of your pirate ship, the sole line of defense against an unseen enemy lurking beneath the waves. With cannon at the ready, you'll load, aim, and fire in a desperate bid to survive the relentless assaults of the deep. You are invited to: Load and Fire: Man your ship's cannon and make every shot count as you face waves of monstrous adversaries rising from the deep. Strategic Defense: Use your strategic skills to manage ammunition and time your reloads, keeping the enemies at bay as long as possible. Mystical Seas: Navigate through fog-laden, uncharted waters filled with dark secrets and hidden dangers. Encounter the Unknown: Prepare for heart-pounding encounters with creatures of the deep, whose forms and abilities are obscured by the ocean's murky depths. Will You Survive... long enough to tell tales of your bravery, or will your would be bounty pull you into the abyss? Set sail with 'The Cursed Deep' for a VR gaming experience full of mystery and suspense, where your skills are tested against the overpowering dangers of the deep.
row.short_description: Dare to navigate 'The Cursed Deep', a gripping VR game where you command a pirate ship fending off the dreaded leviathans. Load cannons, aim true, and repel the monsters of the deep in this immersive test of skill and courage. Will you conquer the depths or be swallowed by the sea's fury?

row.name: Deal With The Devil Chapter: 2 - From Tuonela to Hell
row.detailed_description: Deal With The Devil Chapter: 2 - From Tuonela to Hell: The Killing Begins Step back into a dark and mysterious world in the second chapter, taking players directly into the depths of Hell. This chapter continues John’s journey through Finnish mythology and the underworlds. John, a father who has experienced a tragic loss, made a deal with the lord of the underworld, Hades. Hades needed John's help to access Tuonela and promised to resurrect John’s daughter in return. Along the way, John and Hades discover that Lucifer has stolen the souls from Tuonela and freed the ancient god Perkele. But they are not alone: Players will also step into the shoes of Surma – the relentless soul hunter of Tuonela, who must kill living beings to acquire new souls to keep Tuonela intact. His role is as crucial as John’s and Hades’s, as without new souls, Tuonela may collapse. Your mission is clear: John and Hades travel to Hell to retrieve the Key of Shadows from Lucifer, an ancient artifact that grants the power to control souls and teleport anywhere in the universe. Prepare to face both Perkele and Lucifer, as well as your own past, and see how far you are willing to go to save Tuonela. The game takes a sharp, unexpected turn. 🕹️ Classic 3D Platforming… at First – Run, jump, and collect in a nostalgic adventure. 🧩 Solve Creative, Action-Based Puzzles - Defeat enemies and progress through the game! 🔑 A World Hub – Unlock new areas and uncover the mysteries of the underground temple. 💎 Collect Diamonds - Progress and unlock bonuses throughout the game! 👀 A Completely Normal Ending… – Nothing weird happens.
row.short_description: Explore a mysterious world hub temple and travel to different worlds, collect shiny diamonds and keys, and unlock new levels packed with that nostalgic charm you’ve come to love. It’s everything you’d expect from a fun, lighthearted 3D platformer… Until it isn’t.
row.notes: This game contains violence and blood in its final sequences. While most of the game plays like a traditional lighthearted 3D platformer, the ending features a sudden shift in tone and a depiction of a character using a firearm in a violent manner. There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm, but the unexpected nature of the ending may be unsettling to some players.

row.name: Plenty of Fish in the Sea
row.detailed_description: In Plenty of Fish in the Sea , you dive into the serene, shimmering waters of a peaceful river, where the salmon are not just fish but charming, chatty companions with unique personalities, dreams, and dating preferences. As a friendly aquatic matchmaker (and potential love interest), you’ll engage in heartwarming conversations with a diverse cast of salmon, from poetic deep-thinkers to adventurous thrill-seekers.   Swim through winding streams, moonlit waterfalls, and cozy underwater grottos as you take your fishy friends on delightful dates—whether it’s a scenic drift downriver, a romantic algae-tasting picnic, or a playful game of leaping over waterfalls.   With colorful visuals, a soothing soundtrack of bubbling brooks and gentle chiptune melodies, and branching dialogue choices that shape your relationships, Plenty of Fish in the Sea is a cozy, feel-good experience about connection, companionship, and the simple joys of swimming side by side. Will you find your perfect fishy match?
row.short_description: Plenty of Fish in the Sea is a cozy narrative-driven dating sim where you engage in heartfelt conversations with charming salmon and take them on delightful underwater dates.

row.name: Doll Parts
row.detailed_description: You are a doll who wakes up on the day of her owner's first period. How will you navigate the unfamiliar and increasingly surreal situation? Navigate immersive psychological environments. As the girl's mental state deteriorates, how does your environment change? Solve puzzles to help your owner. Look for solutions in your environment to the problems she's facing. Discover journal pages and gain insight into your world. How did things come to be this way? Survive the horrors of growing up.
row.short_description: Play as a doll trying to help her owner through puberty. Solve puzzles, navigate your environment, and discover journal pages to survive the horrors of growing up.
row.notes: Topics of suicide, menstruation, blood, and various body horror elements.

row.name: Stream Defense Protocol
row.detailed_description: Stream Defense Protocol is an interactive turret defense game where your viewers become the attackers! Chatters join through stream chat or Steam to launch missiles at your base. Upgrade your turret, unlock powerful abilities, and survive against the relentless assault. How long can you hold out?
row.short_description: Stream Defense Protocol is a turret defense game where your viewers become the attackers! Chatters join via stream chat or Steam to launch missiles, while you upgrade and fight for survival. Can you withstand the barrage?

row.name: Zafira
row.detailed_description: Big brain battles, tiny skirts. Strategize your squad of waifus in juicy 5v5 combat, manual or auto; it’s your choice. Just don’t blame the hotties when you lose 'cause you were too busy staring.   Assemble a squad of xxx-tra hot women and pretend it’s for the gameplay ~ Yea… there’s also probably an elf girl who’ll show up in your wet dreams. That’s why you’re here, right?   Top tier gooning material awaits! Get ready for endless wrist workouts with fully animated, spicy sex scenes.   Time travel, memory loss, and a suspicious amount of moaning. Make choices, flirt recklessly, and maybe save the world while you're at it.
row.short_description: Build your squad of dangerously hot waifus, kick butt in 5v5 battles, and unlock epic H-scenes that’ll have you hooked. Time travel, romance, and mind-blowing sex - because saving the world’s not for the prudes or the faint of heart!

All scenes are uncensored.

row.name: Nyanco Channel Engine
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Nyanco Channel Engine , a user-friendly reactive VTuber app designed for gamers, streamers, and creative enthusiasts. Enjoy becoming a VTuber by simply using your microphone (with loopback support) and keyboard inputs—no webcam is necessary. This webcam-free feature helps protect your privacy while you interact with your viewers through a virtual avatar. If you face microphone or audio output issues or require advanced management such as loopback support, installing VoiceMeeter software is recommended. Customize your streaming avatar by using the provided Nyanco character or by easily uploading your own images. Beyond virtual streaming, Nyanco Channel Engine is also a handy gaming assistant, featuring: Built-in Notepad: Conveniently note down strategies, reminders, or streaming notes without exiting your game. Creative Paint Tool: Quickly sketch ideas or annotate captured screen images, enriching your gaming and streaming interactions. Instant Screen Capture (F10): Select and embed parts of your screen into the paint tool, ideal for emphasizing important gameplay moments or explanations. Custom Avatar Setup: You can select two custom images for your avatar: an idle state image (Image A) and a reactive state image (Image B). Use the 'Select Image' button in the UI to select each image separately. Idle Roguelike Mini-Game: A mouse-controlled game where you guide Nyanco through dungeons using arrow keys. Encounter creatures such as goblins (g), skeletons (s), orcs (o), and collect potions (p). Activate automatic gameplay by clicking the 'A' button to enjoy idle gaming. Streamer-Friendly Features: Chroma-Key Mode (F8): Activate or deactivate chroma-key for smooth integration with OBS or Discord. Background Sync (F9): Allows syncing background color directly to your preference. Helpful Tips: Press Alt+F4  to quickly exit the application. Press F2  to access this helpful tutorial at any time. For advanced audio management or troubleshooting microphone and loopback issues, installing Voice Meeter is recommended. The base app is free , displaying a watermark logo. Optional paid DLC is available to remove this watermark for a cleaner streaming appearance. Nyanco Channel Engine —your streaming and gaming companion, designed with your comfort and creativity in mind!
row.short_description: Nyanco Channel Engine is a reactive VTuber simulation app featuring easy mic and keyboard controls, custom avatars, handy creative tools, simple screen capture, and an engaging idle roguelike mini-game. No webcam needed!

row.name: Garden Masters
row.detailed_description: The final product for a team of high school seniors as a part of their game design class, Garden Masters is a free-to-play, fast-paced, first-person gardening game where you aim to make the most money by planting seeds to grow your plant empire. In Garden Masters, there are three unique areas where you can aim to expand your garden. The humble and rustic Breezyglade, the arid and desolate Barrenbloom, and the vividly tropical Sandyshrub. Each area has its own unique environmental hazards, such as animals, insects, crabs, scorpions, and... Sharks?! To amass your garden empire, you must do the following: Buy seeds! Grow Plants! Avoid hazards and fight off pests! Earn Money! So, how much money can you earn?
row.short_description: The final project for a team of high school seniors as part of their game design class, Garden Masters is a free-to-play gardening game with a fast pace.

row.name: Astrohaulers
row.detailed_description: Astrohaulers is a sci-fi package management game that challenges you to build and expand your delivery network across the galaxy. Your mission is to deliver color-coded packages to the correct space stations. As you successfully deliver packages, you’ll unlock new stations and boost your score. Strategize your routes and optimize your deliveries to become the ultimate interstellar hauler! DELIVER PACKAGES You are in charge of coordinating deliveries across different sectors of space. Place packages on ships and send them to their destinations! STRATEGIZE YOUR ROUTES Support efficient deliveries everywhere in your sector by strategically connecting stations. Be wary though, as routes can’t cross each other. Will you better connect important stations or will you be sure packages can get anywhere in your network in reasonable times? ACHIEVE HIGH SCORES Each sector has its own challenges for you to master. Can you beat your high score? Can you beat ours? … OR WATCH YOUR NETWORK DESCEND INTO CHAOS
row.short_description: Astrohaulers is a sci-fi package management game that challenges you to build and expand your delivery network across the galaxy.

row.name: 《负芒之旅  |Journey of Carrying Light》
row.detailed_description: It tells the story of a small ant who has lost his memory, and gradually searches for the truth of the world in the dangerous backyard, and finally overthrows the oppression and domination of bees. The core of the game play is emergent design, which breaks the restrictions of traditional soul games on players' attack actions, and provides players with the ability to freely design their own action modules. In terms of art, stylized cartoons are used to cleverly design the scene from the perspective of insects and plants
row.short_description: Break the limitations of traditional soul games on players' attack actions, and provide players with the ability to freely design their own action modules

row.name: 激情麻将
row.detailed_description: Game Introduction The ultimate 3D anime-style mahjong game — Mahjong Dream is now available! 'Captain, wake up! It's time for mahjong!' As the captain, you will lead your team in Mahjong Dream, using exceptional mahjong skills and strategic thinking to conquer the challenges of another world. Train unique mahjong warriors with extraordinary abilities and unlock exclusive stories with them! Compete against mahjong enthusiasts from around the globe and experience various game modes such as 3-player mahjong, 4-player mahjong, ranking matches, and custom rooms. Easy to learn and play, enjoy the thrill of mahjong anytime, anywhere! Download now and embark on your action-packed mahjong adventure! Game Features ◆ Characters and Scenes: Fully 3D-rendered characters and scenes that seamlessly blend anime style with mahjong elements ◆ Variety of Game Modes: Enjoy multiple game modes for free, catering to both beginners and advanced players ◆ Play with Friends: Create custom rooms and tournaments to enjoy exciting matches with friends online ◆ Immersive Gameplay: Dynamic animations and stunning effects provide an unparalleled mahjong experience that breaks the fourth wall ◆ Customization Options: Adorable character expressions, a variety of voice content, and in-game decorations enhance the fun of each match ※ All currencies, items, and characters in the game are virtual assets and cannot be exchanged for cash or any form of real-world rewards.
row.short_description: 'Mahjong Dream' is the world's first 3D anime-style multiplayer, cross-platform mahjong and card game. It includes Riichi, Sichuan, Taiwanese, Hong Kong Mahjong, Dou Dizhu, Guandan, and more. Lead anime-style mahjong warriors to conquer the competitive mahjong world.

row.name: Awkward Valley
row.detailed_description: Awkward Valley is a totally normal, definitely-not-a-time-loop daily planner sim! Each morning, drag activities from your trusty notebook into your schedule and hit 'Start' to watch your perfectly (or terribly) planned day unfold. Will you be productive, exhausted, or just spiral into existential dread?  Featuring a micro deck-building mechanic, every choice shapes your routine. Convert fatigue into gains at the gym, fuel your soul (or just your stomach) with vending machine snacks, or attend therapy to process your life choices. As you progress, unlock new activities, modifiers, and Rue Valley-inspired oddities—because nothing here is ever truly normal. With illustrations by Awkward Yeti and a healthy dose of absurdity, Awkward Valley! is your chance to micromanage a surreal life - one scheduled breakdown at a time!
row.short_description: Welcome to Awkward Valley! Plan your day, tackle strange activities, and unlock bizarre new options as you go. Gym? Therapy? Vending machine snacks? It’s up to you! Featuring Awkward Yeti’s weird and wonderful characters in a totally normal town.

row.name: Desktop Pals 2
row.detailed_description: Desktop Pals 2 is the ultimate desktop companion game, which allows you to share your desktop with a cute companion of your choice! I believe in trying before buying. You have access to all functionality! If you enjoy the game and want to support it you can get Desktop Pals Gold and unlock more pals. The pals are fully interactive with natural behaviour patterns, and you can also overlay them over your favorite games, so you always have something to do while loading in! The game also features extensive ustomization. You can choose the pals location on your screen, his size, how active he is and more! You can modify the game to your liking.
row.short_description: Desktop Pals 2 is the ultimate desktop companion game, which allows you to share your desktop with a cute companion of your choice!

row.name: Project Freefall
row.detailed_description: Dive into Project Freefall,  free to play in Alpha, where the stakes are as high as the altitude. You and up to seven friends are plummeting towards the earth in this adrenaline-pumping game of tag... but there’s only ONE parachute. The rules are simple: survive. The parachute drops from the plane. Your job? Skydive out of the plane and grab it for yourself. Toss a grenade, spray a fire extinguisher, or dodge the shark as you weave through the clouds in a high-speed aerial chase where alliances are temporary and gravity is permanent. As the ground rushes up to meet you, the intensity skyrockets. It's a hilarious, high-skill dance of chaos where only one can claim the ultimate victory, leaving the rest to an… explosive landing. FEATURES: 8-Player Mayhem: Invite your squad for the ultimate test of friendship and reflexes. More players mean more chaos! Cross-Platform Play: Dive in from either PC or VR. Everyone plays together in the same sky. In-game Voice Chat: Talk with your friends as you plummet through the air. High-Stakes, Simple Rules: Easy to learn, but mastering aerial maneuvers to secure the win at the last second takes true skill. Flex Your Style: Look good while you fall! Project Freefall lets you shop for unique characters and Diver suits to customize your look. What are you waiting for? Download for free and join our Discord to help shape the experience. It’s a race to the bottom - will you land with a prize or a splat?
row.short_description: Grab your squad and dive into a frantic chase for the lone parachute as you play the ultimate game of tag at 10,000 feet! Toss a grenade, spray a fire extinguisher, or dodge the shark as you skydive with your friends. Will you go on to victory or go splat? Free to play in Alpha.

row.name: Crusaderman
row.detailed_description: You are the new crusader amongst the order of the almighty and must uphold the Almighty's teachings and serve out justice in his name! Will you be a paragon of justice, a punisher of the wicked, or will you use the power you wield to strike fear in the eyes of all? Looks like its gonna be quite the adventure for... Crusaderman! Features: Traditional side-view turn-based battles Keyword based branching dialogue system You can challenge almost everyone to fights! Pixel Art made by myself. Original soundtrack developed by myself.
row.short_description: Dish out your own brand of justice in Crusaderman - a new exciting turn-based RPG!

row.name: Hibridya
row.detailed_description: O prólogo está disponível! Hibridya é uma Visual Novel de fantasia, romance e slice of life, que conta a história de Alice, uma garota de 17 anos que vive sua vida normalmente, até que um acontecimento misterioso de repente a leva para um lugar desconhecido. Um lugar onde existem seres mágicos aos quais ela tanto admira e que só vê em histórias. Esse é o mundo dos híbridos: Hibridya. Um mundo que possui uma grande conexão com a Terra desde sua origem e que esconde um grande segredo. Segredo esse que somente alguns conhecem… Enquanto vaga em busca de ajuda, Alice se depara com aqueles que insistem que ela é uma princesa chamada de Evangeline, a princesa do reino onde ela está. Em meio a tudo isso, ela acaba sendo salva por um rapaz misterioso que a leva até um lugar onde passa a conhecer aqueles que serão seus futuros companheiros de morada enquanto ela não descobre uma maneira de voltar para casa. Alice irá fazer novos amigos, aprender coisas novas e também sobre si mesma! Além disso, ela poderá viver (ou não) um romance! Por que Alice foi parar misteriosamente em Hibridya e por qual motivo ela foi confundida com a princesa desse reino? Como ela fará para voltar para casa? Ela realmente conseguirá fazer isso? Uma história com 7 capítulos no total + prólogo e epílogo (cada capítulo será lançado separadamente); Aproximadamente 32k de palavras. Por volta de 2~3 horas de conteúdo (por enquanto, apenas do prólogo); 2 interesses românticos (um deles aparecerá apenas no final do capítulo 3); Viva um romance apenas se quiser! Escolha se seguirá a rota de amizade ou romance; Nome customizável; 15+ personagens; Cenários, ilustrações (CGs), sprites e interface originais; Escolhas para customizar sua experiência; Diferentes variações de finais. Em determinado ponto do jogo, o jogador terá a opção de escolher seguir a rota de amizade ou de romance com um dos interesses românticos. Essa opção aparecerá mais tardiamente para o segundo interesse romântico. Porém, isso apenas acontecerá se forem feitas escolhas específicas no decorrer da história. Tudo o que compõe essa Visual Novel e seu desenvolvimento, exceto a trilha sonora, foi feito por AyaChi-mi, criadora do Colora Games. As músicas e efeitos sonoros foram selecionados em um site com recursos livres de direitos autorais.
row.short_description: Em um piscar de olhos, chega lá... mas nem faz ideia do porquê. Hibridya é uma Visual Novel episódica de fantasia, romance e slice of life onde você acompanhará uma narrativa cheia de emoções, descobertas e reviravoltas, customizando a história da protagonista de algumas maneiras!

row.name: Sisyphi
row.detailed_description: Sisyphi is a casual strategy game about two players (Sisyphus) competing against each other to push their boulder towards the finish line. But there is a twist. The map that you play on is generated from text-to-AI, so you play what you type! With short 15-minute matches, have a fun time with your friends trying to race to the finish. Use skill moves to get a better chance to win! Dev Note : This was a solo project, and offers gameplay the scope of which is restricted by the capabilities of AI. Hence, it's not as expansive as it can be, so go easy on me!
row.short_description: Sisyphi is a casual strategy game about two players (Sisyphus) competing against each other to push their boulder towards the finish line on a map generated based on what the players type.

row.name: Time Gamers: 12000 Years in One Square Mile
row.detailed_description: In a one-square-mile area in the United States, evidence has shown that there have been 12,000 years of continuous human habitation. From Native American, to the first European expedition (de Soto), and first backcountry fort and settlement. In this same area, there were battles of both the American Revolution and the American Civil War. This game/simulation recreates the objects and terrain of this history. You are a time gamer. Until now, time gamers were just explorers. The only thing they could bring back from a parallel universe were the memories of their experience. But new methods and technology will allow you to bring back specially designed devices from the future. Your combined universes have been selected so that such a future device may be found. Specifically, you will need to find a DNA sniffer which will allow you to sample and bring back the DNA of extinct life forms. If successful in your mission, these samples will be used to map the DNA history of Earth. This mapping will allow scientists to build and clone the animals of the future.. animals that will be able to survive the growing challenges of our planet.  Features: Immersive World: From pure native cultures to the first European settlers, you will move through prehistory and through the American Revolution and Civil War, and into the 20th century. But it is an item from the future that is key to mission success. Soundtrack: Original music written by award winning songwriters for this game. It sets the tone and mood for important scenes and leaves you with memorable melodies. 3D Anaglyph Mode: With the press of a key, you can turn the game into 3D. Red/Cyan 3D glasses are required. Historical Narration: As you move around, a narrator will educate you on the true history of each location you enter. You will interact with people of that time. The buildings you encounter have been recreated based on historical documentation and local archaeology work. Critical Decisions: You must find, identify, and sample, key DNA targets. Some of these may be 'hidden'. You must always be looking for clues. Achievements: In addition to DNA targets, you will also have the opportunity to explore and earn many achievements.
row.short_description: You have just been trained and certified as a 'Time Gamer'. Your first task is to travel back in time to the area of the longest running period of continuous human history in the United States. There, you must collect the DNA of extinct animals and important people of the past.

row.name: Days Without Incident
row.detailed_description: VINTAGE SURVIVAL HORROR Days Without Incident is a short, never-before-seen horror experience from We Create Stuff. This lost prototype from 2017 reveals the creative roots of In Sound Mind. Take a nostalgia trip back to the 2010s: keep an eye on your health, make every bullet count, and solve intriguing puzzles as you navigate a haunted factory. DON'T DRINK THE WATER Working off no more than an old newspaper clipping, you've come to the town of Ebenflow to find the answers you've been hunting for. Its people live in the shadow of an awful tragedy; they may want to forget, but you've come to find the truth of what happened to the factory and its workers. Why doesn't anyone drink the water? Features: A Lost Prototype: Experience a previously-unreleased piece of horror history. Noir-Drenched Mystery: Investigate an abandoned metalworks factory that’s plagued by sickness, whispers, and silence. Piece together the hidden truth, and what’s been left to fester… The DNA of Indie Horror: An evolutionary milestone between Nightmare House: The Original Mod and In Sound Mind. Designed to Linger: This survival horror experience is a short 45-60 minutes, sharp and unsettling.
row.short_description: It has been -̷̯͙̔̈́-̴̱̽̓͝-̷̍̊̕͠  days without incident. Your investigation has brought you to an old metalworks factory, abandoned after a series of mysterious deaths. But something’s been growing in the quiet. A short first-person survival horror experience.
row.notes: Days Without Incident features blood, violence, dead bodies, and horrific monsters. Player discretion is advised.

row.name: 混乱纷争
row.detailed_description: 《混乱纷争》是一款即时战略策略游戏。每次开始游戏前，有多样的种族选 进入战斗后，通过对战局的观察进行升级科技强化你的士兵，危难时刻在基地释放种族魔法 通过升级兵营训练更多的士兵为你战斗，欣赏他们战斗的场景 在完成对局后，获得新的装备来提升自己，然后继续征战
row.short_description: 《混乱纷争》是一款类RTS 游戏但不需要时刻专注资源管理，节奏快，操作简单。选择你喜欢的种族和其他三名玩家进行战斗，升级你的士兵们，然后欣赏他们和对手战斗的场景，来一盘简单又轻松的战斗吧。

row.name: Endor Awakens: Roguelite DRPG
row.detailed_description: Endor Awakens is a thrilling evolution of Depths of Endor, a Roguelite DRPG where chaos reigns in the changing world after the fall of Mordoth. In this Dungeon Crawler , you'll venture through procedurally generated dungeons, encountering new challenges and treasures with every step. The city has transformed with new features: Shop : Buy weapons and armor to prepare for your adventures. Inn : Meet new NPCs, take on common quests, and delve into the main story and side adventures. Guilds : Unlock skills via a new skill tree and customize your character to match your playstyle. Bestiary : Track the monsters you've faced and defeated. Bank : Store items you don't need for later use. Daily Chest : Log in every day for rewards and bonuses. Morgue : Resurrect fallen heroes and continue your journey. Create your characters by choosing their race, gender, guild, and portrait. Hardcore mode adds extra challenge: if your character dies, there's no coming back. Pick a custom avatar from your device's gallery to make your hero truly unique. Turn-based combat allows you to strategize every move, whether it's attacking, casting spells, using items, or defending. Beware of traps and events as you explore the depths of dungeons. Endor Awakens offers endless possibilities for adventure, as you forge your path through this ever-changing world. Your choices shape your journey, with each dungeon and character offering new opportunities. Will you rise to defeat the chaos, or succumb to the darkness of the depths? The fate of Endor lies in your hands.
row.short_description: Explore procedurally generated dungeons in this roguelite dungeon crawler. Battle epic monsters, collect loot, and customize your character in strategic turn-based combat. Adapt to a constantly changing world after the fall of Mordoth.
row.reviews: “Un Rogue de manual, bien vitaminado de mecánicas y una buena cantidad de contenido. Un free to play respetuoso con el jugador y una monetización justa. Los amantes del género, en su forma más pura, tenéis aquí una propuesta de lo más atractiva.” DeVuego

row.name: Yet Another One
row.detailed_description: You wake up in unfamiliar environment. Nowhere to go, and the only clue are those strange rune stones. Try to find out what to do next. Your guide? A rabbit with violence issues. Yet Another One is a short, free to play game, focused around one mechanic: drawing runes. You can use them to enhance your movement, light up the surroundings,  teleport or shoot lightnings! Solve puzzles, evade enemies, and find the exit! Try different ways to use each one, or even a few of them together.
row.short_description: Explore vast canyons and treacherous caves where the power of ancient runes is your only weapon. Draw runes to solve puzzles, summon magic, and avoid dangerous creatures, if you can — all while navigating dark, mysterious landscapes. Also, why is the rabbit swearing at me?

row.name: Ranman
row.detailed_description: Step into the shoes of Ranman , a slightly clumsy but incredibly brave hero who accidentally unleashed powerful chaos upon his peaceful kingdom. Your mission is to traverse crazy worlds , filled with colorful platforms, dangerous traps, and bizarre enemies, to fix the damage and restore order. Key Features: Dynamic Levels: Jump, run, and overcome obstacles in meticulously designed levels that blend classic platforming with modern twists. Crazy Power-Ups: Collect coins that grant Ranman special abilities, such as super jump , super damage , or super health . Unique Enemies: Face hordes of foes, from classic creatures to giant bosses guarding each world. Mysterious Secrets: Discover hidden passages, secret levels, and collect all the coins to unlock bonus content. 'Ranman' is the perfect choice for fans of classic platformers who love challenges but also want to have fun. Can you tame the chaos and become a true hero? Ready for the adventure? Dive into Ranman's world and show that you can save the kingdom from total mayhem! 🎮✨
row.short_description: Step into the shoes of Ranman, a clumsy yet brave hero who must fix the chaos in his kingdom! Traverse crazy worlds, collect power-ups, defeat enemies, and uncover secrets to restore order. Can you become a true hero? 🎮✨

row.name: Blackjack 21: Blackjackist

row.name: Study Arcade
row.detailed_description: When you open Study Arcade, you're presented with an extremely simple interface to set a timer and get going. Hit Start, leave it open in the background, and get to work. It'll alert you  automatically when it's time to take a break. Come back after studying, hit Play, and it'll give you a list of arcade minigame for you to play, giving you a break when you need one! I've made 3 minigames so far, from block-breaking to retro shooter (okay, there may or may not be a 4th bonus game). Crucially, though, it only lets you play after you've already been productive, and all of the games are designed to give you a quick brain break and then help you get back to work. Study more to get a chance to play all of them and try to beat the highscore. Escape the doomscrolling, get stuff done, and most importantly, have fun while doing it. Simple as that! The Pomodoro Technique (25 minutes of intense focus followed by 5 minutes of rest) is extremely helpful for more productive studying and working, but let's be honest, we all get distracted pretty easily. My attempts to use the technique looked something like this: set a timer, timer goes off, start scrolling social media or playing a game designed to keep me on for as long as possible, get distracted, and never get back to work. The problem is that most entertainment is designed to monetize your time, the most important resource you have! This free tool helps you solve that problem. It's what I wish I had when I was in school (especially during college), and so I'm putting it out there for free.

Behind each door lies more than just a room—it holds echoes of the past, watching, waiting. You must question everything you see, for every step forward may lead you closer to the truth… or deeper into madness. row.name: Adult Life Yuri Bundle by Team ANPIM
row.detailed_description: Four couples, four yuri stories Want to read yuri? Here's not only 1, but 4 yuri stories featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting. Developed by Team ANPIM: Your quick fix for short, cheesy, and fluffy yuri kinetic novels. Total length: ~112,000 words My Dream Is To Be a Model, Not a Maid! Tanaka Akane is a stubborn and hot-headed 24 year old still chasing her lifetime dream of being a model, but after countless amounts of interviews, she still hasn't landed a permanent modeling job at an agency yet. To make matters worse, she accidentally spills coffee on a rich CEO's daughter and now this stranger demands Akane to be her maid to pay off the damages. How will Akane fare as a maid for this snobby and impossible rich girl? Will she even be able to last a day? Length: ~28,000 words There’s No Way I’d Fall in Love With a Womanizer, Right? Being the type that cares too much to a fault, Asahina Umeko helps out a supposedly drunk girl one night, and she soon finds out that this girl is the hot new celebrity worker at the mall she works at. She's instantly attracted despite their weird first meeting, but all that goes down the drain when Umeko finds out that this girl is a serial womanizer that breaks one too many hearts and with everything pointing to red flags. Umeko swears off falling for her, but can she really resist getting swept up by this womanizer's charisma, or will she end up getting drunk off her? Length: ~30,000 words The Moon That Fell for the Star Tsukimiya Minami is just an ordinary convenience store worker trying to make ends meet—another day, another dollar. But things takes an unexpected turn during a late-night shift when she encounters a mysterious stranger in need of help. Against her better judgment, Minami offers her a place to stay. Little does she know, her new and annoying (yet surprisingly captivating) roommate is more than meets the eye (and ear) with a plate full of troubles. Yet, Minami can’t seem to resist lending a hand. As Minami gains a new temporary roommate, she soon also ends up gaining something else unexpectedly… Length: ~28,000 words Love Goes Toward Love When a new cafe opens right in front of the one Chiyoda Juri works at, tensions begin to rise between the two competing owners. After a fateful encounter, Juri falls in love at first sight with the beautiful and charismatic stranger that saved her life—who just so happens to be the new worker at the rivalling cafe. To make matters worse, her savior already has eyes on someone else! How will Juri deal with these overflowing feelings for someone she shouldn’t have feelings for? Length: ~26,000 words Content warning: Some characters consume alcohol in the story. There is no sexual content in the stories. One character has slightly revealing outfit but no nudity is mentioned or depicted in-game.
row.short_description: Collection of 4 yuri stories by Team ANPIM, featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting.
row.notes: Some characters consume alcohol in the story. There is no sexual content in the stories. One character has slightly revealing outfit but no nudity is mentioned or depicted in-game.

row.name: The Ghost of Alcantra
row.detailed_description: Features:  Free Around 175,000 words Sprites and CGs done by YuukiPudding + Rhealess (14 Sets of Character sprites, plus 26 CGs) Classical music soundtrack Edited photo backgrounds of the Upper Peninsula of Michigan (the setting for the visual novel) Kinetic with a complete ending Takes place in the Midwest The Ghost of Alcantra is a passion project made by four people. It is a free kinetic romance/mystery vn that alternates between two perspectives, one taking place in 1987 and one taking place in 1997. In 1987, Nick Fox meets the mysterious Alexandria (who seems to know more than she lets on) at the Summer Festival of Alcantra. They become closer, but at the same time, Alcantra finds itself the center for a series of murders. In 1997, an unknown narrator gets hit by a motorcycle and ends up in the hospital with amnesia. A detective, Scarlet Storm, informs him that a murder has just occurred and gives him a note found with his belongings that says: “Her blood is on your hands.” He joins Detective Storm to assist in the case in hopes that doing so will help him recover his memories. She tells him that the townspeople think the murder was done for The Ghost of Alcantra. As the events progress, it becomes clear that the events of 1997 are connected to those of 1987. If you’re looking for a fairly lengthy visual novel focused around a central romance and mystery, consider The Ghost of Alcantra. There are many great visual novels that involve different routes or dating sim elements, but if you’re wanting to experience a narrative that emphasizes a singular, fleshed-out story, consider checking out The Ghost of Alcantra. Content Advisory: Profanity, Violence, Gore, Suicide
row.short_description: The Ghost of Alcantra is a free kinetic romance/mystery vn that alternates between two perspectives, one focusing on a blossoming romantic relationship, and another focused on unraveling a murder mystery.

Discover a magical yo-yo that grants incredible powers and embark on a journey to stand up to your bullies. Engage in strategic turn-based combat, master unique yo-yo tricks and spells, and become the hero of your own story in this charming rogue-like adventure. This isn't just any toy; it's an item of incredible magic, offering Emily the power to finally confront the bullies who have made her life difficult. Witness Emily's transformation through vibrant 2D comic-style art and 3D combat that unfolds at key moments in her journey. From a timid target to a confident protagonist, experience her growth as she learns to wield her newfound abilities and discover the true meaning of inner strength. Turn-based Yo-yo Combat Prepare for a unique and engaging combat system! Kwyjibo Adventure features turn-based battles where you'll use your magical yo-yo to perform a variety of tricks and spells. Utilizing your joystick, you'll execute precise movements to unleash powerful attacks and strategic maneuvers against waves of bullies. Discover and master a diverse range of yo-yo techniques, combining them to create devastating combos and outsmart your opponents in tactical showdowns. Rogue-like Progression Each journey in Kwyjibo Adventure is a fresh challenge! Face relentless waves of bullies in procedurally generated encounters. Defeat your adversaries to earn valuable buffs and upgrades that will enhance Emily's abilities and yo-yo skills. With each successful run, you'll grow stronger and unlock new possibilities, encouraging you to experiment with different strategies and builds as you strive to overcome the ever-increasing difficulty.

row.name: Traveler Lost
row.detailed_description: On a journey of self-discovery, a young traveler crosses paths with a majestic-yet-frightened beast. The trek to guide it home shall be one of cooperation and understanding. Traveler Lost is an adventure puzzle game about learning the ways of a mysterious animal companion and working alongside it to guide it home. This odyssey will take you through various biomes, each with their own scenery and mysteries to unravel. Guide your companion forward, explore your environment, and ward off evils as you journey to help a new friend. Your voyage will take you through four locales, including a village, forest, and more. Use your wits to find your way through each one of them, taking into account how your partner interacts with their environment. Pick up objects, rotate statues, and even platform to overcome obstacles in your way and get the creature to travel alongside you. Remember, both you and your companion have your own strengths and weaknesses, so think carefully and use them accordingly! Grab and rotate objects like fruits, crystals, and statues to clear a path forward. Jump across abandoned buildings, rocky platforms, and even your new friend to solve puzzles. Learn to whistle to command and guide your creature confidant directly. Ward away enemies by sending your companion to scare them off. Open gates, redirect light beams, and even help other creatures to make your way atop a great mountain. This is a student project created by undergraduate students at the University of Central Florida.

row.name: Cosmic Concealed
row.detailed_description: Cosmic Concealed: A Galactic Hide & Seek   Welcome to the wackiest game of hide-and-seek this side of the universe! In Cosmic Concealed, players are launched into space-themed settings, which includes Earth, the Starship, or Space! One team hides in plain sight—disguised as everyday sci-fi props—while the other team hunts them down. The clock is ticking to find them and eliminate them. Will you blend in as a bottle on the bridge of a spaceship or a suspicious space cactus. Will you suit up and shoot every suspicious object to uncover your hidden aliens? Features: Hilarious prop transformations: crates, chairs, and more! 3 epic maps: Earth, The Starship or Space Maps include low-gravity as well as normal gravity. Hiders can use voice taunts! It’s hide-and-seek—but in SPACE. Are you prepared to vanish? How to Play In this game, it’s a round-based game; players will be randomly assigned to Hiders or Hunters. The game will conclude by either time running out or the Hunters finding all of the Hiders, and then it will start a new round. Hunters: The players assigned to Hunters will be released at a delay. They are tasked to find and shoot any objects out of place. If they hit a Hider, the prop will disappear, leaving a cloud of smoke. Shoot all the Hiders to win the round. Happy Hunting! Hiders: The players assigned to Hiders will have time to hide and transform into a prop. Hide or move around as the prop to keep hidden from the Hunter. Once time runs out, you win the round. Good luck staying hidden!

row.name: The Bloody Cross
row.detailed_description: The Bloody Cross is a short, narrative-driven top-down game with horror elements, exploring the weight of sin, guilt, and redemption through a Christian lens. You play as a wanderer climbing a mountain that represents moral achievement—only to be met with temptation, failure, and spiritual struggle at every turn. Along the way, you encounter others like you, including Jesus himself, who offers forgiveness and calls you to follow him… even unto the cross. This is not a sanitized or child-friendly Christian game. The Bloody Cross is raw, emotional, and unafraid to deal with disturbing and mature themes—addiction, shame, pride, suicide, and the trauma of trying to be good in a broken world. Through powerful allegory and stark imagery, the game pulls players into an intimate and unsettling reflection on the human condition and the costly grace offered at Calvary. Whether you’re a believer or not, The Bloody Cross offers a bold narrative experience built to challenge, provoke, and stay with you long after the credits roll.

You will connect nodes from output to input to control resource flow and data pipelines Research : Scan files to unlock powerful new technologies via the research tree. Hack : Strategically engage in breaches of organizations through hacking. This provides access to critical intel, enables the disruption of opposing systems, and secures resources vital for your mission. Code : Get contributors by committing important code, Implement custom solutions for your system by crafting code optimizations, developing custom applications, and programming essential drivers. As the AI progresses, it will generate improved files, greatly boosting your income. Guide its development to ultimately achieve Artificial General Intelligence, a pivotal step in overcoming the universal crisis.
row.short_description: A sci-fi management game where you build and optimize your computer's system from the ground up. Connect and configure interconnected nodes to efficiently download, process, and upload files. Manage your setup, solve system challenges, and become the ultimate system architect
