row.name: Make Your Country Dominate Again
row.detailed_description: Make Your Country Dominate Again is a minimalist PvP Super MMO idle strategy game about the collective conquest of territory and the absorption of real-world countries. Why 'Super MMO'? Because players from all over the world — in unlimited numbers — exist on one single, monolithic map at the same time. The player, an immaterial entity, uses their share of influence to help some nations consume others. Player actions are expressed through Arrows — to invade neighboring countries — and Flags — to defend their own. The entire world becomes a superposition of every player's input across the planet. The main goal is to help your country conquer the entire world. That’s the victory condition. Tactically, you focus on generating Energy through a system of Devices. The energy you produce represents your influence as a player in the world. You monitor the charge level of your main Dynamo Machine — the core of your energy production — and strategically activate temporary boosters throughout the day. The Dynamo Machine and other Devices can be upgraded to match your playstyle: Stay active longer in offline mode Generate more Energy during active play Provide temporary boosters for sudden attacks You can always reset the device upgrade tree and experiment with different configurations.
row.short_description: Welcome to a global multiplayer meat grinder. This is a strategy game where you don’t just win — you collectively erase countries from a single, shared world map. Only one nation is allowed to survive!

row.name: 4STORY : The Original
row.detailed_description: Step into the world of Iveria, where two powerful factions — the noble, fortress-strong Defugel and the vast, country-like Craxion — wage war for control of the continent. 4Story is a classic MMORPG with an iconic realm-vs-realm (RvR) system, offering large-scale battles, thrilling PvP, and a dynamic world shaped by conflict. Whether you choose to defend the honor of Defugel or fight for the freedom of Craxion, the battlefield is yours to conquer. Key Features Two-Faction War System Join Defugel or Craxion and take part in massive realm battles, battlegrounds, and sieges that decide the fate of Iveria. Epic Sieges & Territory Wars Capture fortresses, defend outposts, and shape the political map through strategic PvP warfare . Dynamic PvP and PvE Dive into dungeons, raids, and world bosses , or challenge rival players in open-world PvP and structured battlegrounds. Guilds and Alliances Form a guild or join forces with other players to dominate territory wars and large-scale PvP events. Mounts, Gear, and Customization Upgrade your weapons, unlock powerful mounts, and tailor your character to your preferred combat style. Classic MMORPG Feel Easy to learn, deep to master — 4Story combines nostalgic MMORPG charm with community-driven events and war-focused gameplay. Will you stand with Defugel or Craxion? Choose your side and write your legend on the battlefield.
row.short_description: Between Berkilious, the God of Destruction, and Lea, the Goddess of creation, long-lasting antagonism has repeated numerous creations and destructions. In the name of the Goddess Lea, exists the world of Iveria. In this world of chaos, will there be a hero to end this war once and for all?

row.name: XETTER 2020
row.detailed_description: In this action-puzzle game, your goal is to clear each scene by collecting all the dots. There are 30 unique scenes to conquer. You control the main character using either a keyboard, controller, or on-screen joystick. Navigate the stage, avoid enemies, and use blocks strategically to survive. Two types of enemies chase you relentlessly. If they catch you, you lose a life. However, you're not defenseless—by pushing blocks and dropping them from above, you can crush enemies. Be careful though: if you're crushed by a block yourself, you'll also lose a life. Each scene has a time limit. If time runs out, you lose a life. Lose all your lives, and it’s game over. You can restart the current scene at the cost of one life using the [RESTART] button, or return to the title screen using the [QUIT] button. Once you clear a scene, it becomes available for selection from the title screen. Use the [UP] and [DOWN] buttons to choose a previously cleared scene, and use [TO LEFT] or [TO RIGHT] to move the position of the on-screen buttons for comfort. Can you clear all 30 scenes and master every challenge? Additional Controller and Keyboard Functions In the game screen, the [RESTART] button can also be triggered by pressing the controller's [START] button or the keyboard's [Delete] key. In the game screen, the [QUIT] button can also be triggered by pressing the controller's [BACK] button or the keyboard's [Esc] key. In the title screen, the [UP] and [DOWN] buttons can also be triggered by using the controller's D-pad or analog stick (up/down/left/right) or L/R buttons, or by using the keyboard's arrow keys. In the title screen, the [START] button can also be triggered by pressing the controller's [START] button or the keyboard's Space or Enter key. In the game screen, the [TO LEFT] and [TO RIGHT] buttons can also be triggered by pressing the controller's L/R buttons or the keyboard's L/R keys.
row.short_description: Collect all the dots to clear each of the 30 action-puzzle scenes. Dodge two types of enemies, drop blocks to crush them, and avoid being crushed yourself. Use limited lives wisely, restart levels when needed, and unlock cleared scenes for replay. Can you beat them all?

row.name: 怪物联萌-巨龙守护者
row.detailed_description: 《怪物联萌》 是一款采用Q版放置风格打造的游戏，玩家进入游戏需要通过培养英雄卡牌来构建强大的阵容体系，同时利用主城科技研究系统进行休闲养成。游戏以休闲放松为主题，让玩家在愉快的游戏体验中消灭不断涌来的深渊魔物，享受割草的乐趣。随着主线关卡的推进，更多的内容将会呈现，感兴趣的下载与好友一同探索各种创新玩法吧！ 怪物联萌玩法 1、主线关卡 游戏前期的主要玩法，每隔5关会有BOSS关卡，打过后可以领取丰厚的奖励。游戏内大部分玩法的解锁条件是和主线关卡进度挂钩的，前期尽快推进主线进度，可以更早解锁新玩法，快人一步体验新内容，赢取新奖励 2、探索 在挂机的过程中，会获得探索点奖励。通过消耗探索点派遣英雄进行探索，探索完成后会为您带来指定奖励。要注意探索点数的积攒是有上限的，超出上限后再进行快速挂机会浪费探索点，先派遣完毕之后再进行挂机比较合适，另外探索是可以刷出紫色魂石、奇迹卷等超稀有物品的，祝大家好运 3、战争学院 通过获取英雄、英雄升星等方式，完成任务获取钻石和集结宝典。活动长期存在，如果首月内达到6000分还会获得神话英雄自选奖励。此外首月还会开展排名活动，有限定称号和头像框，还有大量奇迹券奖励哦~建议首月在达到6000分的基础上尽可能冲下排名 怪物联萌培养技巧 1、内城培养 内城中首先是4大资源点：主城获取信赖、伐木场获取木头、金矿获取金币、铁矿获取铁块，建议升级顺序是主城→伐木场→铁矿→金矿 2、幸运祭坛 幸运祭坛分为幸运转盘和奇迹转盘，消耗对应卷轴抽取奖励，刷新奖池不会刷新保底次数，建议左上角大奖可以刷新到一个心仪的道具后再进行抽取。 科技馆内随等级提升获取科技点，消耗科技点升级科技，获取强力效果。 竞技场是和玩家对战的地方，获得诸多奖励。每周竞技场战斗达到指定场次还能获得职业券、奇迹券等奖励，千万不要错过~ 3、共鸣水晶 共鸣水晶在城墙达到160级开启，等级最高的9位英雄将为水晶充能，共鸣水晶内的英雄会自动同步位充能英雄中的最低等级。解决你换英雄的烦恼。 在共鸣水晶达到240级，也就是同时拥有9位240级的角色后，将开启水晶突破功能，消耗经验和进阶石可以突破等级上限，提升全体英雄属性
row.short_description: 《怪物联萌-巨龙守护者》是一款采用Q版放置风格打造的游戏，玩家进入游戏需要通过培养英雄卡牌来构建强大的阵容体系，同时利用主城科技研究系统进行休闲养成

row.name: Reelease
row.detailed_description: Reelease is a video player application exclusively for Steam and SteamVR. Watch your favorite videos right from your USB or HDD. You can watch videos in 2D, 3D, 180°, 360° and Anaglyph. - No accounts needed. - No subscriptions needed. - No hassles. Watching videos has been made real easy! Reelease supports video formats of .mp4, .mov, .avi. and .webm. You can watch videos in 2D, 3D, 180°, 360° and Anaglyph. Quick and easy to navigate menu system. View videos within 8 different scenarios on a giant projection screen. Choose from multiple screen border neon colors. Watch from an adjustable view distance. Turn on / off screen emitting light. Turn on / off scene ambient sound. Change the width of the screen from the equivalent of watching 16:9 or 2.4:1. Hide the screen if wanting to just look at the environment. Customize the look of various scenes to display your own posters. Create your own video thumbnail images. Turn on / off subtitles. Choose from multiple menu artwork backgrounds. Choose from multiple pointer models. Watch videos on a flat or curved projection screen. Choose your own paths to your videos and custom content. Change visual quality settings. Interact with various objects within the environments.
row.short_description: Watch videos in 2D, 3D, 180°, 360° and Anaglyph in different environments.

row.name: Gunbot Diplomacy: Blast Off
row.detailed_description: Gunbot Diplomacy: Blast Off is a prologue teaser to Gunbot Diplomacy.  You'll have the opportunity to experiment with multiple Bot builds, providing plenty of replayability and a few hours of potential gameplay. Content available in Blast Off: Two gunbots, eight starting Weapons with plenty of augments and ammo to customize them, 50 Modules + the first ten maps of the game on the base difficulty, featuring 20 unique enemies. Assemble the perfect arsenal of weapons, from nuclear footballs to fire extinguishers that spray electrified flames. Rewire your Gunbot - frame and (artificial) brain - whether it's for speed, durability, or straight up firepower. Welcome to the wasteland; now pick your flavor of carnage! Features: - Infinite replayability! No two bots are the same, so no two runs are the same! -Mix and match from over 20 base weapons and customize them to suit your build on a unique hexagonal upgrade grid -Choose from more than 80 build-defining modules - it's not like messing with Gunbot AI lead to the downfall of all human civilization or anything! -Fast-paced gameplay: let your weapons do the talking and splatter your enemies across the desert, while you dodge out of harm's way! - 10 base Gunbots to choose from, from the gallant LanceBot to the Freezer , the best armed fridge the world has ever seen! -Discover hidden combinations for special evolved weapons to kick your build into overdrive! -Fun and varied enemies: oozified office workers still on their 9-to-5 grind, brawl boys who just want to fight everything that moves, skittering spine-slinging crab/cactus hybrids, and so much more! -Special Hazard and Boss levels to test your build - and skills - in unique conditions! -Let your gunbot's automated targeting systems handle the firing - or select which weapons you want to manually aim for optimal control!
row.short_description: Splatter slimes, massacre mutants, and assemble your perfect Gunbot! Survive the wasteland in this top-down shooter roguelite by customizing your weapons on the unique upgrade grid, and pick from tons of build-defining modules and wacky bots for a new experience every run. Prologue teaser build.

row.name: Touhou Chouhatsuyou ~ Burgeoning Tresses of Longevity
row.detailed_description: An experiment in Gensokyo went disastrously wrong for a few individuals. A mysterious scent has caused every woman's hair to grow to the height of their body. Some of the victims who are fine with their old hair now look unpleasant to themselves. Based on an original screenplay and featuring an original score written by Susumu Takajima, you take control of one of the victims out of a selection of four to find the person who conducted the experiment. You will have to take your super long hair across six stages to find the scent's origin so you can restore it to normal. You can tackle it alone or with a friend.* The weight of your hair will make it challenging to defeat your enemies' danmaku and their spell cards. *Additional accessories may be required for local multiplayer modes. Features: Four playable characters spanning different backgrounds Four difficulty modes with different spell cards A six-stage main game plus a post-game extra stage A series of original characters created by Susumu Takajima to fight against 1990s-style musical score by Susumu Takajima Controller support
row.short_description: A mysterious scent has caused everyone's hair to grow haywire...

row.name: Hero Stickman
row.detailed_description: Hero Stickman is an action-packed fighting game where players take on the role of a powerful stickman warrior, battling through intense levels filled with enemies, challenges, and epic boss fights. Build Your Legend - Endless Heroes, Infinite Possibilities Customize your stickman warrior with unique weapons, armor, and abilities. Unlock rare heroes, each with distinct fighting styles and special moves, to create your ultimate combat team. Every choice shapes your legend! Summon Your Destiny - Assemble the Ultimate Team Collect and upgrade legendary stickman fighters, from nimble assassins to mighty tanks. Strategically combine their skills to dominate the arena. Will you focus on brute strength or tactical synergy? Unleash Chaos - Explosive Battles Await Experience heart-pounding combat with destructible environments and screen-shaking special attacks. Dodge, counter, and unleash devastating ultimate moves in fast-paced 1v1 duels and massive team brawls. Unite & Rise - Build Your Legendary Guild Join forces with players worldwide to form unstoppable guilds. Compete in weekly guild wars, share rare resources, and unlock exclusive guild-exclusive heroes and skins through teamwork. Endless Adventures - Discover Hidden Surprises Explore ever-changing dungeons with randomized challenges and rewards. From ancient temples to futuristic battlefields, each playthrough offers new secrets to uncover and bosses to conquer!
row.short_description: Hero Stickman is an action-packed fighting game where players take on the role of a powerful stickman warrior, battling through intense levels filled with enemies, challenges, and epic boss fights.

row.name: Greatsword Point!
row.detailed_description: Be the strongest greatsword user in this game world. Defend your point by swinging your greatsword, and parrying attacks. Game can be played offline.  Story You are retired and have you own territory. The Oranges are back! Stronger and smarter! Only you can hold them back, as you are still the strongest greatsword user in the world! Though you are pretty old right now. Information to know Spend Magic Ingots to temporarily empower you to your former self. You can gain this by playing the game or in-app-purchase. Game is designed for smartphone; the UI will likely look gigantic. The game uses PlayFab for account and leaderboard. The cloud save should be able to load into both PC version and Android version. Disclaimer: currency is stored into your save data. Purchase while logged in for the save to update to the cloud. Or log in after purchasing. Please be careful when there is a difference in Local Data and Cloud Data, confirming in choosing one will override the other. You can play through the entire game without logging in at all. If you win continuously, the entire campaign should be around 20 minutes. Game is meant to be played for fun, small amount of time needed. Not designed for playing hours on end.
row.short_description: Swing your greatsword and hold your point! Only you can effortlessly and endlessly fend off armies of Oranges! There is no one else up to the task!

row.name: Double Down
row.detailed_description: Double Down is a rogue-like FPS for high-octane high rollers. You are The Dealer, one of the card dealers for the Triple 0 Casino. Well… former card dealer. You and your fellow employees have been replaced with an advanced AI called The House. It can supposedly do everything the humans can, but better. No pay required. You only manage to take a few steps out the door before the AI takes over the casino. Now it’s up to you to defeat your enemies, get chips, and tip the odds in your favor as you descend through the Casino to get your job back. Spin slots, risk it all on roulette, and go all in on ante to power your way through endless waves of enemies. Mix and match dozens of unique upgrades to tear through the robot horde. Save up your chips and cash them in to venture deeper into the Triple 0 Casino, and face the AI overlord behind it all. You aren’t the only one getting upgrades. Look out for elite robots with big buffs and dangerous special abilities. Bet on the roulette to get special challenges, but don’t slow down, or you might lose it all. Learn more about The House and the Triple 0 Casino as you make your way through the hand-crafted levels. Double Down was developed over 1 academic year as a part of Champlain College's Game Studio Capstone program.
row.short_description: Double Down is a roguelike FPS for high-octane high rollers. Smash robots and spin slots to win powerful upgrades, and make your way through growing waves of enemies to face The House and take back the casino.

row.name: ShaderGlass
row.detailed_description: Overlay for running GPU shaders on top of Windows desktop. Features applies shader effects on top of desktop, in a floating window or full-screen built-in RetroArch shader library (1200+ shaders!) covering: CRT monitor simulation image upscaling TV, VHS and handheld simulation softening, denoising, blur, sharpen and many more works with most emulators, retro platforms and pixel art editors including: DOSBox , FS-UAE , Altirra , ScummVM , AGS , VICE , Aseprite etc. excellent companion for pixel art showing shaded and/or aspect-ratio corrected preview you can even use it on top of YouTube, Twitch or modern games saving and loading profiles import of external .slangp/.slang shaders high customizability with various options, operating modes and shader parameters can be captured by OBS (using Game Capture source) Please refer to the manual for option explanation and tips on tuning to achieve best effects.
row.short_description: Tool for applying shader effects on top of Windows desktop for gaming, pixel art and video.

row.name: Prism of You
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Prism , a unique emotional sandbox simulation where the player's goal is balance. Identify, engage, and express eccentric alien creatures that represent human emotions. What’s hiding in the dark fog? Using sounds, movement patterns, and thoughts as hints, learn how to identify your emotions before you can start engaging with them. It gets easier as you go! It’s important to engage with your emotions in a healthy way instead of bottling them up. Give your Emoes attention to maintain them, and build structures to help manage your Emoes more effectively. Your Emoes also have unique properties. Emoes of the same type can merge to create higher intensity emotions, and Emoes holding too much charge will split into more Emoes. Learn how to manage your population of Emoes and keep your Prism in a steady equilibrium. Expressing your emotions can be relieving and cathartic. Express your Emoes to release charge from the system and help keep your Prism in balance. Obtain unique collectibles through experimentation and play to shed light on the mysterious origins of the Prism.
row.short_description: Experiment with emotions in this emergent sandbox simulation by identifying, engaging, and expressing dynamic creatures known as Emoes -- all while trying to maintain balance and uncover the secrets of this mysterious alien world.

row.name: Spaceship Man 2
row.detailed_description: It's time to go fight in space.  Spaceship Man 2 answers the questions, 'What would it be like if I went to go fight in outer space? What would I fight? Who would I meet? What lies beyond the distant limits of the human perception of our own existence? What if I couldn't die?' The casual gameplay of an arcade space-shooter meets the rogue-like element of random boons that reward adaptive playstyles. Spam the spacebar to deal damage as fast as you can, learn the best way to utilize the gifts that random NPCs give you, how to obtain potions that allow you to activate your accumulating powers and when to use them, all to a killer, entrancing soundtrack composed and produced by Placeless. The skilled will be tested, the curious will be rewarded, and you can't die.   Music by Placeless.  Sounds by Zapsplat.  Font engine by Scribble.
row.short_description: It's time to go fight in space. Good thing I can't die.
row.notes: Some characters wear mildly revealing outfits and use some PG-13 language.

row.name: The Truth of a Snowy Night
row.detailed_description: This game is a collection of ghost stories of people climbing Everest. If you find an anomaly, you must solve the situation. Otherwise, your teammates will disappear one by one. You will not get out of here alive. How would you solve the bizarre phenomena in this game? Will you ever escape from this place?
row.short_description: This is a single horror game that collects the horror stories of people who have climbed Everest. Play it if you want to have a similar experience to them, or if you think you can handle it. You never know where the truth lies in extreme horror.

row.name: Sisyphe's Backspace
row.detailed_description: A narrative game about love and hesitation—about the words that you wish to say but never could. Features: Minimalistic art-style with text-only presentation. Minimalistic gameplay, using Backspace button to progress. A short yet meaningful experience narrative experience, witness a five-minute conversation between friends. Made by Koway
row.short_description: A 5 minutes game about love and hesitation. Use Backspace to play. Hope you will never experience this hesitation.

row.name: Red Cap Squad: Zombie Source Playtest
Dread Not
row.detailed_description: The water is dark and incredibly cold. The pressure is intense, and the stakes couldn’t be higher... After being attacked by a colossal sea creature, a small nuclear submarine is thrown into a high-stakes battle and must reach the surface before air runs out. Players take on the role of either Pilot or Mechanic and must work together to keep the submarine stable by communicating with each other, fixing failing systems, and navigating through perilous waters. Survival depends on the pair’s ability to work together under immense pressure. Failure is not an option.   Dread Not is an asymmetric co-op game created by Leviathan Interactive, a studio comprised of 15 UW-Stout students, that will leave players wanting more! Play as a pair of marine researchers aboard a doomed vessel that has suffered severe damage and only has 10 minutes before running out of oxygen. The only chance of reaching the surface is by making repairs, which are completed through cooperative and individual puzzles scattered throughout the system rooms of the submarine. The Pilot is constrained to a single room and is in charge of navigation while simultaneously communicating with the Mechanic in order to keep necessary systems up and running. The Mechanic is able to move between all other rooms and must repair systems under the Pilot's guidance. With inspirations taken from real 1960’s Navy Nuclear Ballistic Missile submarines of the George Washington Class combined with the 80's vibes found in cinematic classics such as The Hunt for Red October and Jaws , Dread Not is sure to be an absolute blast. Will you sync or swim?
row.short_description: Avoid your watery grave in this asymmetrical co-op horror game where you and a friend take the roles of a submarine Pilot and Mechanic. Work together to repair the ship, solve puzzles, avoid a deadly creature, and make it back to the surface before time runs out! It's time to Sync or Swim
row.notes: Depictions of stressful situations and claustrophobic environments. Unnerving creatures and circumstances.

row.name: Blade & Soul Heroes
row.detailed_description: The Story Journey with Yusol as she strives to rebuild her clan and enact justice against those who destroyed it. Follow her as she pursues the evil Yi Chun and unravels the mysteries of the Heaven's Fall Cult. Along the way, she’ll encounter an expansive cast of heroes, each with their own skills and story, who will join her resurgent clan and unite in the fight to defeat Yi Chun and Heaven’s Fall. Dual Combat System Seamlessly switch between turn-based strategy and real-time action. In turn-based mode, all five team members take the battle field to unite for victory. For real-time action, one designated lead hero fights the various enemies supported by four skill-linked allies Character Collection Build & grow your 5-hero team to begin your journey. With over 40 heroes to unlock, each with their unique skills & stories, a variety of legendary characters awaits you to join your clan. Visual Style Immerse yourself in this anime-inspired world with majestic vistas, eerie forests, ancient deserts, and mythical dungeons of the Earthen Realm. Each hero models a distinctive look and feel evocative of the elements. Deep Tactical Combat To defeat your foes, master your fighting abilities with a wide array of combinations and skills. With each battle, tailor your team strategically in order to achieve victory across different opponents and environments.
row.short_description: This thrilling free-to-play Collectible Action MMORPG offers the duality of turn-based strategy & real-time action. Experience exciting cross-platform play and embark on an epic quest where numerous stories are waiting to be discovered alongside your five member team. Unite your heroes!

row.name: Proptop Demo
row.detailed_description: Do you have what it takes to hide in plain sight or hunt down the hidden? PROPTOP  is an intense multiplayer hide-and-seek game where players transform into everyday objects to evade hunters or track down disguised props! 🔥 Key Features: ✅ Thrilling Hide & Seek Gameplay – Disguise yourself as a prop or take on the role of a hunter in fast-paced, strategic matches. ✅ Dynamic Maps – Explore a variety of unique environments designed for maximum hiding and hunting fun. ✅ Deceptive Disguises – Blend in with your surroundings by mimicking objects and outsmarting your pursuers. ✅ Exciting Abilities & Power-Ups – Use special skills to escape, mislead, or track down opponents. ✅ Multiplayer Madness – Play with friends or challenge players worldwide in action-packed matches. Will you be the ultimate hider, the relentless hunter, or the mastermind who outplays them all? Join the game now and test your skills! 🔫 Hunt. Hide. Survive. 🎭
row.short_description: Do you have what it takes to hide in plain sight or hunt down the hidden? PROPTOP is an intense multiplayer hide-and-seek game where players transform into everyday objects to evade hunters or track down disguised props!

row.name: Cooperate with Yourself
row.detailed_description: - Just like the name says, 'Cooperate with Yourself' Use 18 different keys to control up to six characters simultaneously and reach the goal. You'll face a variety of tricky obstacles that can't be overcome without perfect cooperation. Clear all 16 levels and make it to the ending! - Features 2D platformer A co-op experience in single-player Fully customizable key bindings Time trial mode Adjustable screen aspect ratio
row.short_description: This game is a 2D platformer where a single player controls up to six characters. In other words, it's a game that lets you experience a multiplayer co-op game all by yourself. Work together, use each other as stepping stones when needed, and clear all 16 levels!

row.name: Buck Trucker in Rowdy Business
row.detailed_description: BUCK TRUCKER'S ADVENTURE BEGINS YEEE HAW! Buckle up for the first installment of the Buck Trucker adventures! Follow the outrageous exploits of Buck Trucker as he heads to the Golden Palm Casino - Las Vegas, Nevada with one mission: save the orphanage back home in Clay County, West Virginia.  Buck Trucker in Rowdy Business delivers a quick-hittin' replayable romp, perfect for anyone who wants the text adventure experience, without the complexity and length. 'GAMES. GAMES. GAMES. WINNERS AND LOSERS' Put Buck's gambling skills to the test with realistic casino games! Try your luck at the blackjack table, pull the lever on the Lucky Tug Slot Machine, or place your bets at the horse racing track. Every dollar counts when you're savin’ them orphans... or does Buck have other plans? The choice is yours, cowboy. MEET CRAZY CHARACTERS ALONG THE WAY Cross paths with a cast of Vegas lowlifes, high rollers, and everyone in between. Help Buck make decisions that will lead to wildly different outcomes - will Buck save them orphans, find true love, or end up in a dumpster behind the Golden Palm Casino? Experience the story through hand-crafted character portraits and scenes that bring Buck's rowdy adventures to life. ACHIEVEMENTS Have you got what it takes to be a real Trucker? Unlock 20 achievements that'll have you exploring every seedy corner of the Golden Palm Casino.  Will you discover all possible endings? Can you maintain a clean conscience in a city of sin?  The only question is, which path will you choose?
row.short_description: Buck Trucker must gamble and sweet-talk his way through The Golden Palm Casino, Las Vegas, to save an orphanage back home—or succumb to Sin City's many temptations in this choice-driven story featuring mini-games, multiple endings, and a cast of outlandish characters.
row.notes: Descriptions of sexual activity.

row.name: Bibelgame
row.detailed_description: Uebersicht Bibelgame ist ein 2D Jump and Run Spiel, das dich auf eine spannende Reise durch zentrale Geschichten der Bibel mitnimmt. In mehreren liebevoll gestalteten Levels erlebst du interaktiv bekannte Begebenheiten wie die Schoepfung, die Arche Noah oder das Leben von Jesus. Das Spiel richtet sich an Kinder, Jugendliche und Familien und verbindet Spielspass mit wertvollen biblischen Inhalten. Erkunde die Welt der Bibel in einem neuen Format und lerne spielerisch mehr ueber die wichtigsten Personen und Ereignisse der Heiligen Schrift. Jede Episode ist eingebettet in eine klare Geschichte, leicht verstaendlich und mit kurzen Bibelzitaten unterstuetzt. Schluesselmerkmale 2D Jump and Run Gameplay mit intuitiver Steuerung Mehrere Levels basierend auf biblischen Geschichten Abwechslungsreiche Grafiken und Charaktere Spielerisch lernen mit Spass und Tiefgang Ideal fuer Kinder, Jugendliche und Familien Kein Vorwissen erforderlich Weitere Informationen Bibelgame ist ideal fuer den Einsatz in Familien, Schulen oder Gemeinden geeignet. Es motiviert dazu, sich mit der Bibel zu beschaeftigen und bietet eine sichere und positive Spielerfahrung.
row.short_description: Ein 2D Jump and Run Spiel, das biblische Geschichten spielerisch erlebbar macht. Sammle Schriftrollen, loese Raetsel und erlebe die Bibel wie nie zuvor – spannend, lehrreich und kindgerecht gestaltet.

row.name: Dream Prison
row.detailed_description: 'Dream Prison' is a 3D horror escape game similar to Exit 8. Find the anomalous rooms and escape the cult church. [Game Background] You wake up in a church, and a voice guides you to the room on the left. The path out of the church is unusually winding, but not without clues. row.detailed_description: With the upcoming merger approaching, play as one of four animal company leaders looking to dominate the competition through an intense game of golf. But for stakes so high, they've agreed to mix things up a little. And thus, the hunt is on! Fire in the Hole is a top-down twin-stick shooter featuring four animals all duking it out on the golf course. It is a local PVP and controllers are recommended (although one player can use Mouse and Keyboard) and the game is intended for 2-4 players . Shoot down competition to prevent them from scoring their golf balls into holes! The player with the highest score wins the match! But we didn't leave out rewards for the losers. Every player, even losers, can earn themselves accolades; from getting the most golf ball KOs to missing the most golf ball holes, there's bound to be something for everyone on the course. While Fire in the Hole can be played with one player on a mouse and keyboard, we fully recommend players to use a controller in order to best experience the game! The game teaches the player how to play before entering combat, but we've provided a manual as well that outlines both controller and keyboard controls, as well as potential upgrades and dangers you may encounter on the golf course. Fire in the Hole offers : 5 Unique Gun-Clubs! 5 Different Golf Balls! 4 Specialized Power-Ups! And 4 Arenas each with their Own Hazards! We don't teach you everything though. Experimental players might be rewarded with a fun discovery! This game is being developed for our 2025 Capstone Project in the Honours Bachelor of Game Design Program at Sheridan College, Oakville, Ontario, Canada. Fire in the Hole was made by 6 game designers and 1 composer over 28 weeks of development! If you like what you see, please consider checking out the other works of the individuals listed in the credits! Shoot us a message - we don't bite!

row.name: Pudding UP!
row.detailed_description: Sweetness hides behind extreme difficulty! Take control of a cute pudding and escape from the maze of a supermarket and refrigerator. But don’t be fooled by the cute visuals — this game is no walk in the park. Simple Controls! Drag the pudding to jump! The controls are intuitive, but mastering them is another story. This game will test your patience to the limit. High Difficulty, Extreme Challenge Fall once, and you’re back to square one… One wrong move can cost you everything. The tension is real, but the satisfaction of success will make it all worthwhile. The Charm of Pudding Up Lies in Its Unique Theme and Mechanics The game stands out with its well-defined food theme, where various food characters come to life. The gameplay also introduces bounce ball-inspired items that add a strategic element to the challenge. Mastering the bounce mechanics will help you discover hidden paths and shortcuts. Throughout the game, you’ll also encounter NPCs shaped like different foods. These NPCs will either lend you a helping hand or create unexpected obstacles, adding variety and depth to the gameplay. Your Goal: Escape! Your mission is to guide the pudding out of the supermarket and refrigerator. Can you handle the challenge and lead the pudding to freedom? The pudding’s fate is in your hands. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

row.name: Zombie Graveyard Simulator - Prologue
row.detailed_description: THIS PROLOGUE FEATURES Limited play up to 6 days Limited progress on upgrades Limited number of store items (defenses, decoration objects etc.) Locked features such as employees and bank/loan system Limited weapon variety Limited zombie types No endgame content Progress will not carry over to the full release About the Game In a world where the dead turn into zombies, your job is to manage your very own Graveyard! Perform burials and cremations, and fulfill visitor requests with special flowers and gravestones by day. But when night falls, everything changes. The dead may rest, but the zombies don’t. They are coming for your precious work. Will you be able to protect them? Visitor Satisfaction is Key After processing the bodies, visitors will regularly return to check on their loved ones. Your duty is to keep graves clean and intact while providing fresh flowers to ensure their satisfaction. Every visit rewards you with valuable bonuses to help keep your business running smoothly. Build your Defenses Each night, waves of zombies will come with their numbers growing and special zombie types emerging, hungry for freshly buried bodies and the freshest of all, you. From basic defenses like barbed wires and fences to advanced machines like automatic turrets, keep your defenses upgraded, repaired, and fully stocked with ammo to withstand the night. Trust your Arsenal With a variety of weapons, including pistols, rifles, shotguns, and your trusty shovel, you are the ultimate force against the Zombies. As you level up, unlock and purchase new weapons while upgrading your skills to become even stronger. Just make sure to stock up on enough ammo! Even a Graveyard Can Be Cozy Sometimes! Use your Farming Area to grow different flowers for profit and vegetables to simply eat and restore your energy and health. With Upgrades, you can even unlock a Grinder to turn zombie parts into Fertilizer. Decorate your Graveyard with statues, lights, and other ornaments to make it truly your own. Expand and Upgrade Your Facilities Your graveyard isn’t just a resting place, it's a business, and every upgrade matters. Expand your burial area to accommodate more bodies and improve your crematorium with additional furnaces, automated cleaning systems, and faster processing times. Upgrade your farming area for better resource production, and enhance your water supply from a simple well to a motorized pump and water tank to keep everything running efficiently. Every improvement helps you stay one step ahead of both business demands and the undead threat. Key Features Manage and expand your own graveyard while balancing business and survival. Build defenses and fight off nightly zombie attacks. Perform burials, cremations, and keep visitors satisfied. Upgrade facilities like the crematorium, farming area, and water supply. Unlock new weapons and improve your skills. Customize and decorate your graveyard. Experience a mix of management, strategy, and first-person action.
row.short_description: Manage your Graveyard by day as you bury and cremate bodies, maintain graves, fulfill visitor requests, grow crops, and unlock upgrades. When night falls, face relentless zombie hordes as you build defenses to protect your work and fight to survive in Zombie Graveyard Simulator - Prologue!

row.name: Immersive APM
row.detailed_description: This is not a game but a software observability tool. A monthly subscription is required. Visit out web site for details and to get started with your account. Once you have an account and your application is generating telemetry, get the Immersive APM client and view that data.  Join us on Discord or send an email to get help. Immersive APM, developed by Immersive Fusion, is an innovative Application Performance Monitoring (APM) solution that transforms how engineers monitor and manage software applications. Unlike traditional APM tools that rely heavily on log analysis or two-dimensional dashboards, Immersive APM leverages advanced web, 3D, and Virtual Reality (VR) technologies to provide a fully interactive, three-dimensional view of application telemetry in real-time. At its core, Immersive APM integrates with the OpenTelemetry observability framework, a widely adopted standard for collecting telemetry data such as traces, logs, and metrics from applications. This data is processed and rendered into a dynamic, 3D environment that engineers can explore using VR headsets, AR devices, or standard web interfaces. This immersive approach allows users to 'enter the world of their application,' visualizing its architecture, processes, and performance metrics in an intuitive, spatial context—akin to navigating a virtual landscape. Key features of Immersive APM include its ability to offer a centralized, real-time view of an application’s health, making it easier to spot issues like bottlenecks or failures that might be obscured in conventional tools. Engineers can interact with individual transactions, inspect parallel processes, and perform rapid root-cause analysis, often within minutes. The solution is cloud-native, supporting a range of deployment types—on-premise, containerized, serverless, or hybrid—as long as the application has internet connectivity to communicate with Immersive APM servers. Beyond technical capabilities, Immersive APM enhances collaboration by providing a shared, immersive space where teams can troubleshoot together, improving communication and decision-making. It’s particularly valuable for complex, distributed systems, offering a 'single pane of glass' that consolidates performance data into one cohesive, navigable experience. This combination of cutting-edge visualization, streamlined integration, and practical utility aims to reduce downtime, boost productivity, and redefine how software performance is understood and optimized.
row.short_description: Immersive APM transforms how engineers monitor and manage software applications. Immersive APM leverages advanced web, 3D, and VR technologies to provide a fully interactive, three-dimensional view of application telemetry in real-time.

row.name: Vibrant Dash
row.detailed_description: Vibrant Dash is a first-person plaformer with a twist : The world map is a pixel grid. In this grid, EVERY pixel is a new procedural level . row.name: RockStars!

Unique Instruments and Abilities  New instruments are introduced gradually, each containing unique attacks and abilities essential to overcoming specific challenges and progressing through the story.  Diverse Platforming Challenges  Players navigate diverse terrains such as canyons, caves, and psychedelic levels. the use of traditional moving and jumping in combination with a variety of special abilities. Platforming utilizes the player’s base movement and jump abilities in combination with the special abilities of different instruments.  Narrative Cutscenes and Dialogue  Players engage in a story told through cutscenes, gameplay dialogue, and NPC interactions. row.short_description: 'RockStars!' is a third-person action adventure game set in an alien planet with a 70's retro psychedelic style. When Aero's rocket minivan crash lands on a hostile alien planet, they must use the abilities of different instruments to find their band members and escape.

row.name: When the Crow Sings

Over the past few hundred years, the American fauna has evolved to survive the rapidly decaying environment. Tensions between intelligent animals called EVOs and humans are strained, and there are not many places where the two factions live in tandem. Westend Falls is one of the few compounds still fostering cooperative action, and it is highly exclusive. Chance has been accepted into this compound as their home has finally slipped into unlivable conditions, but once they’re in there's no coming or going. As Chance settles in, things are not as peaceful as they seem. They realize that while they may have come here willingly, there's no leaving. It was created by a 15 person team over the course of 8 months. WHEN THE CROW SINGS is currently in development.

Void Stalkers
row.detailed_description: Void Stalkers is a cosmic horror game set in a dystopian future where you are a Void Runner - the pilot of a cargo space ship, under the employ of the WASP corporation. Your job? Transport dangerous creatures known as Void Stalkers to WASP's various research stations. Sounds easy - except your ship is falling apart, traveling The Void is never safe, and the Void Stalkers aren't dormant. Use your ship's security cameras, drone, and other systems to find and deal with anomalies, fires, reactor malfunctions, and other strange things in The Void. Use your ship's security cameras to monitor your ship and your cargo to ensure everything is as it should be. The Void Stalkers you are transporting begin in stasis, but can awaken during travel through The Void, causing reality-warping anomalies. Spot these anomalies and zap the creatures back into stasis before they fully wake. Fail, and you'll need to act quickly to lure them to an airlock and blast them into space before they get to you. Your ship configuration changes with every jump. Create paths for your drone to connect to different terminals or deal with threats directly! A lot can go wrong in The Void. Fires, biomass, trajectory misalignment, infestations, reactor problems, and more! Meet other Void Runners, deal with WASP's management and scientists, and communicate with other factions such as the Lunar Resistance. Each of them will want something from you and most of them have their own agenda. It's up to you how you play - keep your head down and follow orders, side with the resistance, or just look out for yourself. The choices you make impact what you learn and how you survive. It is the year 2972. After centuries of automation, AI, downsizing, and corporate mergers, 99% of Earth’s population is jobless. The unemployed live idle, pointless lives, subsisting on government provided food and living quarters. You were meant for more than that. But jobs aren’t earned. They’re won in a lottery, sponsored by the mega-corps. And against all odds, you’ve been selected. Congratulations! You’re a Void Runner now. Your prize? Minimal training, a barely functioning cargo starship, and 1,000,000,000 credits in debt. What? You didn’t think they’d give you a free ship, did you? And then there’s the cargo. Dangerous Void Stalkers that your new employer, Whitestone Agriculture Transport and Pharmaceuticals (WASP), say they want to study to create new medicines and technology to benefit all of mankind. The Lunar Resistance says otherwise, but they have their own agenda too. The other Void Runners seem to be on the level, but can you fully trust them? The Void is cold and uncaring. The corporations and factions are even worse. Every void jump pushes you deeper into a system designed to exploit you - or worse. But this is what you’ve always wanted. You’ve got your ship, your freedom (sort of), and a purpose. Make the most of it!

row.name: NYIP (Demo)
row.detailed_description: The year is 1389. The Serbian army, led by Tzar Lazar, clashed with the vast forces of the Ottoman Empire in their ruthless conquest. Thousands have fallen, rivers run red with blood — but far greater evils still lie in wait. With the knights slain, the ancient protector has also fallen, leaving the mythical Tower of Prizren unguarded... NYIP is a top-down action RPG with souls-like combat, set in a grim fantasy world shaped by the forgotten myths and brutal history of medieval Serbia. As the smoke still rises over the battlefield of Kosovo, something ancient stirs — navs , the death-spirits of Slavic folklore, now walk among the corpses. Drawn by visions of the Prizren Tower — a mystical structure said to bridge realms — you, the player, are called to step into a world where dynasties crumble and forgotten gods stir in the shadows. Face legendary figures reimagined through a mythic lens, battle twisted creatures born from authentic Slavic lore, and ultimately decide the fate of Kosovo by claiming the Tower itself. Will you rise to shape destiny — or will you be consumed by it? Step into a bold, historically sensitive interpretation of one of Balkan history's most impactful and symbolically charged battles. We don’t recreate history — we reimagine its echoes through the lens of dark fantasy. The Battle of Kosovo has lived on for centuries — not only in chronicles, but in poetry, epic songs, and the collective memory of an entire region. Yet, no game until now has dared to approach its mythic weight. NYIP bridges historical reverence with immersive storytelling, treating the past not as a fixed set of facts, but as fertile ground for emotional and symbolic exploration. NYIP invites players into a setting unlike any other — a world where history, legend, and folklore intertwine across the haunted remnants of medieval Serbia. This is a land shaped by real locations, real names, and real echoes of a cultural past rarely explored in games. From the mist-veiled ruins of Samodreža Church to the cursed fields of Kosovo Polje, every environment is rooted in authentic geography and lore. Here, myth walks hand in hand with history: encounter reimagined figures such as Vila Ravijojla , the ethereal guardian of warriors; Tzarizza  Milica , torn between duty and prophecy; Vuk Branković , shrouded in betrayal and shadow; Miloš Obilić , elevated to near-mythic vengeance; and even Sultan Murat , caught in a fate that defies time... NYIP offers challenging, deliberate combat rooted in the souls-like tradition — every strike matters, every dodge is a choice, and every encounter could be your last. But brute strength alone won’t carry you. The world itself must be understood: its symbols, its silences, and the ancient forces that still whisper beneath its soil.  On your journey, you collect nav souls, that are not just for leveling but could also be used for casting spells. row.name: TyranoStudio Visual Novel Scripting
row.detailed_description: About This Software A free tool for creating smartphone-ready visual novels. Experience the future of game development with multi-platform support. Publish your game across Windows, Mac, iPhone, Android, and web browsers. Totally free. No commercial restrictions. Full customization allowed! Over 20,000 games have been created with TyranoScript. Join a thriving, well-documented community. Key Features ☆ Cross-platform support with flexible distribution options ☆ Games made with TyranoScript run smoothly on a wide variety of platforms. Distribute your game as a Windows application, macOS app, iPhone/Android app , or even as a browser game or embedded in a website . Reach players wherever they are. ☆ Simple to use — but packed with powerful features ☆ No programming experience? No problem. TyranoScript uses easy-to-understand tags , so even artists and beginners can create fully-featured games. Despite its simplicity, it offers powerful visual and interactive capabilities . TyranoScript is also used in many professionally-developed games. If you’ve ever thought making a game was impossible — this is your chance. Give it a try! ☆ Freeware with full commercial rights ☆ TyranoScript is completely free to use — even for commercial projects. Whether you're an individual, a company, or a team , you can use it without restriction. And if you’re developing a game, you’re free to modify or customize the engine to suit your needs. Differences from TyranoBuilder TyranoBuilder is a GUI‑driven tool that relies on drag‑and‑drop—anyone can create a game simply by combining ready‑made components. The trade‑off for this ease of use is a slight reduction in development freedom. Tyrano Studio, on the other hand, lets creators build games by writing its own text‑based scripting language. Because you work directly in script, it offers far greater creative freedom and is better suited to full‑scale, professional game development.

row.detailed_description: Ploy is a rogue-lite turn-based strategy game. You have to reach the last level by destroying and capturing the opponent's creatures and building up a strong team. You can also enhance your pieces by leveling them up to increase their movesets. Key Features Fight against different opponents Capture the opponent's creatures and add them to your team Design your own start formation Level up the creatures and expand their moveset Find all 12 creatures Credits Everything except for the audios by me, aka RookGameDev Audios - Music Tension orchestra chords - frankum  Small Adventurers - ShadyDave Ambient Acoustic - StrangerEight Epic trailer action music 2 by humanoide9000 Sfx Number increase - DrMinky Punch - CGEffex Button Click - original_sound Upgrade - colorsCrimsonTears Scene Transition - newlocknew Move Pop Up - Marevnik Piece Move - dave.des Failure And Victory Sound - FunWithSound Capture Sound - PerMagnusLindborg Thanks to all my testers! About me I am a solo developer from Germany but based in Copenhagen, Denmark. I develop my games in my spare time. Ploy is the first game I have ever produced, so thank you for playing!
row.short_description: Imagine chess but with capturing, team building, and creatures!

row.name: Numbra
row.detailed_description: In a desolate and ominous world, a young girl faces dark creatures that lurk in every shadow. With each step, the danger grows. But there is only one rule: stay awake. Explore the dark world of Numbra Solve puzzles and escape from the enemies And stay awake! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: In a desolate and ominous world, a young girl faces dark creatures that lurk in every shadow. With each step, the danger grows. But there is only one rule: stay awake.

row.name: あれぐろもるとをはこぶゲーム
row.detailed_description: 🎮 About This Game Help the Vtuber “Allegro Molto” reach her live streaming room! “あれぐろもるとをはこぶゲーム” is a casual action game featuring the Japanese Vtuber Allegro Molto and  Lead the cat . Take control of Lead and guide Allegro Molto to the goal—just make sure she doesn’t fall along the way! Be careful, but don’t waste time—this is a game of balance and speed!  📦 Features A simple action game starring Allegro Molto and  Lead the cat (includes 1 stage) Easy controls : Tap or click the left and right sides of the screen to play Reach a score of 100 to clear the game —drop Molto and it’s game over! Each session takes 2 to 5 minutes , perfect for quick play sessions Retry as many times as you like —fast-paced and replay-friendly No ads, no in-app purchases, no DLC —just pure gameplay! 🕹️ How to Play Click or tap the right side of the screen to make Lead move faster Click or tap the left side to slow Lead down
row.short_description: A casual action game starring the Vtuber Allegro Molto and Lead the cat. Balance speed and care as you carry her safely to the live streaming room!

row.name: Ze Bomber
row.detailed_description: Free Bomber game. Use the Keys AWSD to control the bomber and Space to drop bombs. You need to destroy the tanks before they reach the church.
row.short_description: Free Bomber game

row.name: Bobcos
row.detailed_description: Bobcos is a vibrant 2D online multiplayer sandbox game where you can create, explore, and express yourself. Build your own personal world using blocks and decorative items, shape the environment to your liking, and bring your imagination to life. From peaceful forests to bustling towns, your world is entirely yours to design. Customize your avatar with a wide variety of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles. Visit other players' worlds, chat, explore, and form friendships in a lively and welcoming community. Trade items with friends, go fishing, and unlock rare collectibles. The game features a persistent online world—your progress, builds, and collections are always saved, even when you're offline. Whether you're a builder, a collector, or someone who just wants to chill with others in a cozy virtual world, Bobcos offers a relaxing and endlessly creative multiplayer experience. With seasonal events and frequent updates, there’s always something new to discover.
row.short_description: Bobcos is a 2D multiplayer sandbox game where you can build your own world, trade with others, fish, chat, and customize your avatar. Create personal worlds, run shops, and explore a persistent online world with seasonal events and regular updates.

row.name: Living In Infinity
row.detailed_description: About This Game About 40 minutes A short linear narrative adventure   Story Overview From hunger, the world began to unravel. The whole story started with a mushroom—strange, silent, and wrong. The moment Lin Meizhen ate it, her entire world began to twist into something unrecognizable—doors emerge where none should be; familiar things wear unfamiliar skins; shadows in the walls begin to breathe... In a house where reality warps and shadows whisper, can she uncover the truth before the fog consumes her?   How to Play Use specific items to shift between overlapping realities. Navigate a dual world to uncover puzzle clues, unlock new areas, and piece together the truth about yourself.   Key Features u Shift between mirrored realities to uncover hidden truths. u Solve puzzles, each a thread woven into the fabric of the story. u Survive with only your instincts and the safety of a quiet hiding place. u Immerse yourself in an emotional narrative, where warmth and hope flicker even in the darkest corners.   Character Profile Lin Meizhen Age: 17 A high school student with a deep love for literature and art. Currently on leave of absence for unknown reasons.   Game Overview Play as Lin Meizhen, a high school student who eats a suspicious mushroom at home—only to find her world twisting and distorting. A missing door? A strange room? Mushrooms appearing out of nowhere? When everyday objects reveal a hidden side, the truth may lie at the edge of hallucination.
row.short_description: Living In Infinity is a puzzle adventure focused on switching between parallel realities and using various items to solve mysteries. Play as Lin Meizhen, a 17-year-old high school student who eats a suspicious mushroom at home—only to find her familiar surroundings beginning to twist and distort.

row.name: Operation : Escape
row.detailed_description: 2D Top-Down game with pixel graphics in Operation : Escape, will let you survive and fight with enemy by using Melee and Range combat style to escape from this place. STORY You are the criminals that trying to escape the police. While escaping, something took you out of the world from far away, and that's thing didn't help you. They want something from you. BATTLE AGAINST 'THEM' Fighting enemy by using weapons in total of 5 different styles to play with, and use some Melee combat to regain some resources to survive from this place OBJECTIVE Your goal is simple— escape . But it won’t be easy. Each room is filled with enemies and powerful bosses, all eager to welcome you with open arms ... and deadly force. Show off your skills and fight your way out! ENERGY MANAGEMENT Your energy is limited and is used for healing and reloading weapons . The only way to regain energy is through melee attacks (Right Click) on enemies —so choose your fights wisely. WEAPONS There are five different weapon types , each with its own unique function, ammo type, and ultimate ability . However, each weapon also consumes a different amount of energy when reloading , so manage your resources carefully. ENEMIES Enemies come in three distinct types , each with its own attack patterns and behaviors . Stay alert and adapt to their tactics as you fight to escape.
row.short_description: A sci-fi top-down shooter game. 2D top-downYou shooting game. You get kidnapped by alien from far away and infested by their blood, which makes you able to use their weapon. You have to get out there before they catch you and do some weird thing with your body

row.name: Midnight Date Unleashed
row.detailed_description: Midnight Date Unleashed is a Racing Dating Sim that reimagines the thrill of the road. In this game, it's not about crossing the finish line first—it's about driving with style to impress your beautiful passenger. Perform breathtaking maneuvers, drift through neon-lit streets, and take control of the night as you build the perfect Heart Score to win her affection. 🔥 Key Features 🔥 🚗 Drive to Impress Master the art of smooth drifting, precise acceleration, and bold maneuvers to make your date's heart race—both figuratively and literally! But beware—reckless driving and crashing will ruin the mood. Find the perfect balance of thrill and control to create an unforgettable ride. 💖 Real-Time Character Reactions Your passenger will respond dynamically to your driving skills. Show off the right moves, and you’ll see her excitement grow through facial expressions and body language. However, push things too far, and she might get nervous or even frustrated! There are four levels of excitement, so pay close attention to her reactions. 🌆 Explore Thai-Inspired Roads Race through beautifully designed environments based on real locations in Thailand, including: 🏙️ Bangkok’s Neon Streets – A dazzling cityscape full of vibrant nightlife. 🌊 Pattaya Beachside Drive – A romantic coastal route with stunning ocean views. 📸 Unlock Exclusive Date Memories The better you drive, the more special moments you unlock! Reach the highest Heart Score to collect unique date photos, proving you’ve mastered the art of romantic driving. 🎶 Electrifying Soundtrack Set the mood for your midnight ride with a pulse-pounding soundtrack featuring a fusion of Hyper Pop, Hard style, and City Pop . Whether you're gliding through neon streets or pushing the limits on a winding mountain road, the music will keep your adrenaline high and your heart racing. 🏁 Are You Ready for the Ultimate Midnight Date? Take the wheel and experience a thrilling mix of high-speed romance, stylish driving, and unforgettable nights . In Midnight Date Unleashed , every turn is a chance to impress, and every ride is a date to remember! Choose your girls, and don’t forget to pick your perfect ride! You can drift to impress! Enjoy seeing the girls' reactions in real time!
row.short_description: Midnight Date Unleashed is a Racing Dating Sim where stylish driving wins hearts. Impress your date with drifts and stunts on neon-lit, Thai-inspired streets. Earn Heart Points, and enjoy a Hyper Pop, Hard style, and City Pop soundtrack. Can you master the art of love on the road?

row.name: MASTERMIND
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the Mastermind’s deadly game show! Since you're here that mean you're now one of the Mastermind's pawn. As one of the unfortunate contestants, you must endure his brutal challenges and fight to survive. Will you become the showstopper, or being another pigfeed. MASTERMIND™ is a survival strategy game that blends resource and time management mechanics. You must plan your actions carefully, survive the hordes of enemies coming your way. Supply gathering is critical and time is limited, your only objective is to survive with what you have. Remember, use trap, gather supply and be the best survivor to pass through this hell. Features : Randomized!  - Each playthrough offers a unique experience with randomized layouts, trap position and gift box ,forcing you to adapt and strategize. Create your route!  - Find your perfect route the outsmart enemies and obstacles. Loot the place!  - Search for supplies that will aid your survival. Every item you find could mean the difference between life and death. Be the trapper!  - Lay traps to gain the upper hand against threats... or trapped yourself and dies! Upgrade!  - Use collected coupons to enhance your abilities and increase your chances of survival. Objective : Survive through the Mastermind's game show to stay alive. Scavenge for resources to improve your survival chances. Complete various objectives to progress to the next challenge. Manage your time and supplies wisely—both are extremely limited. Developer’s Note : This game was originally developed as a university thesis project. We poured our passion and dedication into creating an engaging survival experience for players. We value your feedback and are committed to improving the game based on player input.
row.short_description: As the survivors in the game show. You will have to prepare yourself with every opportunity possible to arm and supply yourself with weapons and gear. Fight your way through the show with or without Preparation which you will have to make do with what you have.
row.notes: This game contains combat violence where players use firearms such as pistols and shotguns to eliminate enemies. Some scenes might depict mild acts of violence, but excluding themes of suicide and torture. Some enemies may have disturbing appearances with exposed teeth and minor horror elements.

row.name: Tankazooka
row.detailed_description: Tankazooka is a single-player platformer where players follow a small tank travelling with its convoy when it rolls onto a landmine, gets blown up and breaks its sprockets. Now, the tank has to travel through different environments to catch up to its convoy, using its barrel gun to shoot and jump forward in a crumbling world being tarnished by war. Traverse through the 3 different environments and try and get the fastest score you can. Discover short cuts, work out better strategies, but be careful not to fall and lose your progress.
row.short_description: A single-player, 2D platformer game playing as a broken tank that rocket jumps over obstacles and environments.

row.name: GAZED
row.detailed_description: You are stuck in a maze with one to three other players. There is only one goal: find them, see them, GAZE THEM, before they find you. GAZED is a game about using your wits and abilities to outsmart and outplay your friends. Navigate around a procedurally generated maze, hunting players while they hunt you. Use a wide range of abilities to learn whereabouts, gain a strategic edge, or deceive the competition. Abilities are selected in groups of three, so find what combination fits your playstyle best. From slinking around the map slowly gathering information, strategically placing baits and red herrings, or running in head-first hoping to get the drop on someone, there are abilities that support the way you want to play. Broken record pieces are scattered across the maze. Find four pieces to put the record back together, and play it at a record player to become invincible until the song stops. Your opponents can do the same, so find them quick to gain a significant advantage. When death comes in an instant, you must be on your guard at all times. Use your abilities, anticipate their movements, track their location, mislead their ears, deceive their eyes... ...but whatever you do, don't get
row.short_description: An online PVP game about finding other players before they find you. Use deception and information from a variety of unique abilities to gain an edge. There are many ways to play, but only one way to lose. So whatever you do, don't get GAZED.

row.name: Magecraft: Spellbuilding
row.detailed_description: Magecraft: Spellbuilding is a deckbuilder with a focus on crafting your own spell cards and creating unique decks to take with you into the turn-based combat of the Dungeons. While you have control over the cards you start with, the randomized Dungeon layouts, enemy encounters, passive powers, and scrolls ensure that no two runs are the same. Take on enemy attacks, destroying them to keep yourself safe from harm - or take the hit and attack enemies directly to do as much damage as possible. Fight your way through three distinct, themed dungeons, each with its own sets of enemies to defeat, powers and scrolls to collect, and events with with different choices to make. Combine over 50 Sigils - with effects that deal damage, inflict debuffs, grant buffs, summon allies, and more - to craft custom spell cards for your deck. Choose between a variety of appearances, color palettes, and unique Background powers when creating a character - and unlock new character colors to change into, as well as new characters with powerful abilities. The Abyss is a separate mode with randomized characters and starting decks, where unlike the main game, dying means starting a new run from the very beginning.
row.short_description: Craft spell cards, collect new effects, and build the perfect deck as you fight through rounds of turn-based combat. Survive randomly-generated dungeon layouts by countering enemy attacks with your own spells, and make the most of the powers and scrolls you pick up along the way.

row.name: Elysium Elect
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Elysium Elect! [ Elysium Elect ] is an intense climbing adventure set within an endless dream. Your goal is simple yet daunting: ascend continuously to break free from the nightmare's grip and uncover the secrets of the slumbering world. This journey is the ultimate test of your skill and resolve. You will traverse a series of ever-shifting, surreal dreamscapes—from deep mines and collapsing ruins to intricate spatial mazes and magical realms. Along the way, you must execute precise jumps across floating platforms, deftly evade deadly traps, and utilize the dreamworld's strange mechanisms to progress. As you push forward, the challenges intensify. You will face increasingly surreal trials: finding your balance on dizzying illusionary bridges, making critical choices at forks in the road, and ultimately mustering the courage for a decisive leap of faith. Each successful ascent unlocks a new, more breathtaking and bizarre domain. This epic voyage across the boundaries of imagination awaits your first step.
row.short_description: Can you conquer your inner fears and reach the dream's summit? Elysium Elect is a challenging 3D platformer where you explore profound dreams, navigate through surreal worlds with precise jumps, and uncover the secrets hidden within.

row.name: Fear the Timeloop - Prologue
row.detailed_description: Fear the Timeloop - Prologue is a third-person survival horror set within a time loop. Play the first hour of the game in this prologue to the main story. You play as Sheriff James Cooper, who wakes up in an unfamiliar room, severely wounded and bleeding. If he doesn’t tend to his injury, he will bleed out within fifteen minutes — and the cycle will begin again. However, despite his critical condition, James must face an even greater threat: bloodthirsty monsters. The building he’s trying to escape from is surrounded by unknown individuals, ready to kill anyone who attempts to step outside. Key Features: A time loop at the core of both story and gameplay mechanics. A flexible ability system that can be tailored to your preferred playstyle. A branching dialogue system that reacts to your early choices and the path you take through the loop. Metroidvania-inspired elements that let you revisit previously inaccessible areas to unlock new abilities and discover valuable items.
row.short_description: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.
row.notes: This game may feature content unsuitable for all ages or inappropriate for viewing at work, including frequent violence, gore, and generally mature themes.

row.name: Sounds of Shadows
row.detailed_description: Sounds of Shadows is a horror game where you play as B4-BY, a helper robot who worked for 4 scientists in an underground facility who were researching a new groundbreaking technology. You will be going through the facility to learn what happened and to save anyone who's still alive, but there is something else with you in the facility, something blind and dangerous. Learn about the history of this place through scattered voice logs as you avoid the thing lurking in the dark. See your environment through making sound. Sneak your way through, don't let it hear you, distract it by throwing the things left behind.
row.short_description: You wake up as a robot in a dark place, deep underground. There is a voice inside your head. follow it to find out what happened. Navigate the facility through sound, but don't be too loud. It has great hearing. Uncover the history of unfortunate souls in this first person sci-fi horror game.
row.notes: It is a horror game with a scary monster in it, Thus the monster is the mature content

row.name: Entropia Universe
row.detailed_description: Entropia Universe is a unique massively multiplayer online game (MMO) where virtual assets hold real-world value and players can participate in a thriving virtual sandbox economy. The platform has been live since 2003 and continues to push the boundaries of virtual economy design. Set in a persistent, single-shard universe, Entropia Universe offers a deep and evolving sci-fi world spanning multiple planets and vast space environments. Unlike traditional class-based MMOs, players progress through infinite skill development, with the freedom to define their own roles and paths. Players can invest in in-game companies, own land areas, and even acquire shares that pay real dividends, connecting gameplay with genuine economic opportunity. Given its 'no-class' system, and real cash economy, Entropia Universe has many professions that players can specialize and participate in such as: Hunting - Hunt creatures, fight bosses, complete dungeons Mining - survey the land and extract resources used in crafting Crafting - Craft items in demand Trading - Buy low, sell high. Become a skilled entrepreneur  Taming Creatures - Tame sought-after creatures around the universe and sell them for profit Beauty Services - Skill up and offer avatar modification services Shop Owning - Buy and run your very own shop in a persistent world Land Area Owning - Own a huge slice of virtual land to generate revenue from taxes Investing - Buy and sell shares on the Entropia Exchange PvP - Take on other players in lootable PvP Entropia Universe has just launched its brand new  tutorial and starting experience for the game. This new starter zone: Setesh , provides new colonists with a better start in the universe than ever possible before - so don't miss the opportunity to try Entropia today and be a part of a new Golden Age!
row.short_description: Entropia Universe is a unique massively multiplayer online game (MMO) where virtual assets hold real-world value and players can participate in a thriving virtual sandbox economy.
row.notes: Players are able to hunt and kill other creatures and players.

row.name: 少年名将
row.detailed_description: 游戏概述 《少年名将》是一款以三国题材为背景的竖版炫技卡牌策略游戏，融合了放置养成与策略对战的玩法。玩家将通过招募和培养强大的武将，搭配独特的元素灵石系统，体验三国乱世的争霸之旅。游戏以精美的画面和丰富的玩法为核心，提供了多种养成路径和策略组合，让玩家在轻松放置的同时，也能享受深度的策略对抗。 游戏核心特色 三国题材与卡牌策略 以经典三国故事为背景，玩家可以招募并培养数百位历史名将，包括稀有的天金神将。 通过巧妙的武将搭配和元素灵石系统，解锁全新的御灵之术，提升战斗力。 竖版操作与轻松放置 竖版画面设计，适合单手操作，随时随地享受游戏。 放置玩法让玩家在离线时也能获得资源和经验，轻松养成强力武将。 丰富的福利与奖励 登录第8天赠送S+核心辅助武将诸葛亮。 任意累计充值30元即可激活月卡，每日特惠礼包提供20倍返利。 累计登录10天可获得免费110次招募机会，通关主线7-10送名将册*5。 多样化的玩法系统 试炼副本 ：13级开启，包含银币、经验、装备和锦囊副本，每日可免费扫荡2次。 守卫荆州 ：25级解锁，击败多波敌人获得技能加成和丰厚奖励。 阵营夺魁 ：开服第8天开启，玩家根据最强阵容分配到魏、蜀、吴、群四个阵营，参与预选赛和决赛争夺霸主称号。 逐鹿中原 ：开服第3、5、7天开启，采用单败淘汰制，决出冠军、亚军、季军和殿军，提供丰富的排名奖励和竞猜玩法。 深度策略与竞技体验 武将技能、神兽效果、藏品羁绊等多种养成路径，策略组合丰富。 竞技场、跨服玩法等PVP内容，考验玩家的阵容搭配和操作技巧。 游戏玩法详解 试炼副本 开启条件 ：13级（银币副本）、16级（经验副本）、22级（装备副本）、26级（锦囊副本）。 规则 ：挑战副本获得对应养成道具，通关后可扫荡。每日免费扫荡2次，付费1次，VIP等级可增加额外次数。 守卫荆州 开启条件 ：25级。 规则 ：每关遇到多波敌人，击败一定波次后可选择技能加成。关卡通过后无法重复挑战，提供首通和波次奖励。 阵营夺魁 开启条件 ：开服第8天。 规则 ：每周一、三、五开启，玩家根据阵容分配到四个阵营。预选赛20轮后，前8名进入决赛，决出阵营霸主。 逐鹿中原 开启条件 ：开服第3、5、7天及后续每周二、四、六21:00。 规则 ：单败淘汰制，64强玩家参与，分为8个赛区进行8轮比赛。提供赛前竞猜、实时竞猜和红包玩法，最终排名奖励包括专属头像框和丰厚道具。 其他特色内容 神魔系统 神魔战令提供自选箱子，可选择新神魔武将（箱子会随新神魔更新）。 神魔链接可随时更换，但需消耗100元宝。 军团玩法 军团副本通过后，日常挑战任务仍存在。 军团长48小时不上线将自动转让，优先副团长或按贡献度排序。 技能与机制 武将技能和天赋效果多样，例如钟会技能基于全体最大生命值，魔赵云的追击普攻无法触发张辽锦囊。 玄武的负面效果抵消机制、女娲护盾与龙咒的交互等，增加了策略深度。 总结
row.short_description: 《少年名将》是一款结合三国题材、卡牌策略与放置养成的创新游戏，适合喜欢轻松操作但追求深度策略的玩家。通过丰富的玩法系统、强大的福利机制和多样化的武将养成，玩家可以在三国乱世中体验招募名将、攻城略地、一统天下的快感。无论是单人副本挑战还是跨服竞技对抗，游戏都能提供持续的新鲜感和成就感。

row.name: Invasive Species
row.detailed_description: Invasive Species is a silly, hectic, and sometimes difficult, couch co-op tower defence game. You and your friend grow plants to defend your Grandfather's greenhouse against wave after wave of the Alien-Robot invasion. Grow your plants in pots and put them into position on the windowsills overlooking the backyard and provide them with hand-grown ammunition. Robots will be shot on sight! Game features 3D static camera gameplay Grow different plants as towers to shoot at approaching enemies Grow different ammunition and feed it to the plants Hectic logistics as your plants need to be positioned correctly in order to fire and are in constant need of fresh ammunition Earn spendable Scrap (money) by defeating robots! Purchase new pots to fill up every window Purchase upgrades for you plants Purchase new kinds of plants to fight robots with Do a High Five with your friend to ensure optimal cooperation! Invasive Species is a student project made by a group of 10 people over 8 weeks.
row.short_description: Invasive Species is a couch co-op tower defense game where you and your friend plant towers in pots to protect your grandparents greenhouse from the robot invasion! Get scrap from defeating enemies and buy upgrades in the catalogue to fend off against more difficult waves of enemies.

row.name: Ragdoll Boxing Multiplayer
row.detailed_description: Step into the ring with Ragdoll Boxing, a thrilling boxing experience built entirely on precise, real-time physics. Feel every punch, swing, and knockout as you control your boxer through active ragdoll mechanics, ensuring each fight feels uniquely dynamic and unpredictable. Challenge friends in intense multiplayer battles, or test your skills against AI opponents that will push your boxing finesse to the limit. Train your technique and timing using customizable punching bags, refining the perfect rotation to amplify your strikes and maximize your damage output. Whether you prefer keyboard and mouse precision or the intuitive feel of a controller, Ragdoll Boxing adapts seamlessly to your preferred play style. Master the physics-based combat system, delivering punches with careful rotations and strategic movements that determine the power behind every hit. Experience spectacular knockouts powered by a sophisticated physics-driven system, making each KO uniquely satisfying. Ragdoll Boxing isn't just about fighting—it's about perfecting the sweet science of boxing through precise control and impeccable timing.
row.short_description: Dive into Ragdoll Boxing, the ultimate physics-driven boxing game where every punch counts. Powered entirely by realistic, real-time physics, this game brings you closer to the raw excitement and unpredictability of a genuine boxing match. Control your boxer with intuitive active ragdoll mechanics.

row.name: GOO-B3-R
row.detailed_description: Hello from Team Goo! Welcome to GOO-B3-R! Thi s is an initial prototype of a Singleplayer 3D Puzzle Platformer made by Team Goo, a group of college students from the University of Silicon Valley! The game itself revolves around using different types of goo to travel to the end of various levels. Bounce up high using the Bounce Goo, which bounces you up to the same height you start at. Speed along the ground using the Speed goo, removing any friction from the ground. And climb up walls or lock yourself onto the floor using the Sticky Goo! The only limit is your creativity! And now, a message from GOO Labs. Welcome to GOO Prototype Labs A state of the art, one of a kind product testing facility, entirely automated by the most highly advanced robotic testers. GOO Prototype Labs has released many well acclaimed products, from the Anti-Wrinkle De-age Cream to the GOOp Gun! Witness the most advanced lab money can buy, watch our test bots work 23 hours a day, 7 days a week, and behold science at peak efficiency. Our Brand New Products: The Goo Series! Currently in the works is our highly advanced Goo series of products! Compatible with the GOOp Gun, the Goo series promises high utility, multi-purposed liquid materials to assist in any task. Bounce heavy objects into the air using our Super Springy Frog Bouncing Goo! Speed along the ground with our Mega Cheetah Speed Goo!
