row.short_description: Welcome to GOO Prototype Labs, a state of the art testing facility of the future! Take the role of B3-R in this old school 3D puzzle platformer and attempt to free yourself using the brand new GOO Product Line! The limit is your creativity!

row.name: Goblins & Gun Runnin’
row.detailed_description: Goblins & gun runnin` is a goofy slapstick top down shooter with rouge like, like gameplay. Your favourite cheese has been stolen by the pesky goblins so you must enter the belly of the beast and save your precious cheddar. Fight your way through the murky dungeons with fun goofy guns and interestingly weird characters.
row.short_description: Goblins & Gun runnin` is a short rouge like like game where you venture down into a dungeon of goblins and other creatures to save your cheese. the dungeon is scalable to how you want to play. if you want to do a small run make the dungeon small or a big dungeon for long playthrough
row.notes: there is Slight blood and use of guns and other weapons

row.name: Core of Magic
row.detailed_description: Core of Magic is set in a high fantasy world where you can play as a mage, druid, or blood summoner, killing monsters, collecting loot, and solving quests. *The game world consists of leveling hubs where you can wait for monsters to spawn, but there is also a small overall world where you can do quests. *Wilderness areas become available by completing quests. *The game world consists of 3 acts that become available to you as you progress. How many quests are there? And what futures? - 13 main quests - 11 side quests - 4 Uber quests - the game has more than 400 items - Items in the game include white, magic, unique, and rare types. - 3 difficulty settings: Normal, Nightmare, Hell. Note: There are no microtransactions in the game despite it being free to play
row.short_description: Ancient gods and demons have been haunting the people of Steelmoor for months, and it's up to the hero to defeat evil. Is dark magic at play? Who is responsible for this?

row.name: Testimony of Shew: Depths of Sheol
row.detailed_description: Step into a world where every leap and every dodge tells a story. In Testimony of Shew , you’ll navigate breathtaking landscapes, unravel a compelling narrative, and master precise movement to overcome challenges. This is not a game, its an experience. Key Features: Engaging Storytelling: Experience a deeply immersive tale woven into the platforming action. Fluid Jump & Dodge Mechanics: Precision movement is your key to survival—evade hazards, traverse obstacles, and uncover secrets. Dynamic Environments: Explore beautifully crafted levels designed to challenge your reflexes and unravel the narrative. Stylized Art & Atmosphere: Lose yourself in a visually striking world filled with mystery and emotion.
row.short_description: Testimony of Shew is a narrative driven Third-person/Side-scroller platformer, based on a true story, told in symbolism. Traverse through a dark world filled with meaning. Master the art of dodging and perfect your timing as you face increasingly challenging obstacles.
row.notes: drug, alcohol abuse, and self-harm

row.name: Springuins
row.detailed_description: Take on the role of two penguins, Flare and Breeze, far from their icy home, as they journey through a blooming springtime world in this charming pixel art puzzle adventure. In Springuins , you control Flare—but when you collect a cherry blossom, Breeze wants to follow its scent for a few precious steps, synchronizing their movement. Use this mechanic to navigate tight puzzles and reunite the pair across vibrant, handcrafted levels. Features: A unique one-controls-two puzzle mechanic. Bite-sized levels full of clever movement challenges. Cute retro-style pixel art with a charming color palette. A cozy soundtrack to waddle along with. Can you bring Flare and Breeze together?
row.short_description: Take on the role of Flare and Breeze, far from their home, as they try to make their way through the blooming spring in this puzzle game adventure. Control a single penguin to collect cherry blossoms that sync their movements to reunite the pair across challenging, cleverly designed levels.

row.name: Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start
row.detailed_description: Full Version Premiere on September 9, 2025 About the Game Sweet Start is not just a taste of what's to come - it’s a standalone experience that lets you explore the mechanics and atmosphere of building your candy empire Please remember that this is just the beginning of an amazing adventure that awaits you in Candy Shop Simulator! BEGIN YOUR SWEET ADVENTURE! Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is your first step into the world of confectionery entrepreneurship. Open your small shop and get to know the basics of managing your business, crafting delightful treats, and serving customers. It’s the ideal starting point for your journey toward becoming a candy tycoon! CREATE UNIQUE PASTRIES Sweet Start gives you the chance to experiment with basic recipes for sweets in the full version of Candy Shop Simulator you will get a massive range ons sweets. Unleash your creativity and craft delightful pastries that will charm your customers. This is a great way to familiarize yourself with the production process, which will be even more advanced in the full version of the game. Learn how to manage sales and build relationships with patrons - skills that will be essential in the full version of Candy Shop Simulator. PREPARE FOR MORE! Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is just the beginning of your adventure. The full version of the game offers so much more—from new recipes and shop expansions to advanced marketing strategies and team management. Sweet Start gives you a taste of what’s waiting for you in the future! Candy Shop Simulator: Sweet Start is the perfect option for those who want to test their skills and explore the world of Candy Shop Simulator before committing to the full version. It’s not just a prologue - it’s a standalone experience that prepares you for even greater challenges ahead!
row.short_description: Sweet Start is the perfect introduction to the world of Candy Shop Simulator, designed for players who want to dive into the sweet universe of the game and get familiar with its foundations before experiencing the full version

row.name: Pick Up Your Masks
row.detailed_description: Criminals have left FFP masks in the wild with impunity! Help Mimi dispose of the masks he's collected on his walks, in wooden skips! You must collect a minimum number of masks to advance to the next level. If a mask falls to the ground, the game ends. The fixed cat's paw is located in the bottom right-hand corner and, when clicked, releases a mask that falls where you wish. Each situation has its own technique. You can send several in a second to make weight in the dumpster and unlock the hooves in two wastes, or use it sparingly to pile up the masks with the utmost precision. The cat's mobile paw flies continuously from left to right at constant speed. It's up to you to know when to press the moving cat's paw (1) to succeed in cramming as many masks as possible into the bucket. The size of the bucket varies from level to level. You must complete each objective by throwing as many masks as possible into the bucket. The garbage is already in the skips and taking up space. They'll give you a hard time in your quest on every level. Masks bounce off them or get stuck in between, creating traffic jams. It's up to you to make the most of them, applying bounces that work in your favor. The floor is synonymous with GAME OVER. When a mask comes into contact with it, the game ends and you can't throw any more masks.
row.short_description: Throw as many masks as possible into the garbage can before one falls to the ground in the 24 levels.

row.name: The Treasure Below
row.detailed_description: Dive into danger, sharpen your blade, and test your skill. The Treasure Below is a third person action game with stylized medieval visuals, satisfying melee combat, and ever-increasing challenges. Master a variety of weapons , each with unique attacks and skills—fast moving swords, long reaching polearms, heavy-hitting great axes, and more. Arena Mode puts your skill to the test: fight through escalating waves of monsters , each deadlier than the last. Survive long enough, and you’ll earn access to greater rewards and tougher challenges. Adventure Mode  Descend into dangerous dungeons and uncover ancient treasures in a series of handcrafted levels. Online Co-op Team up with a friend to take on monsters together. No PvP—just pure cooperative action. There’s no story, no lore, no cutscenes —just pure gameplay. Jump in, gear up, and see how far you can go.
row.short_description: A third person action game with satisfying melee combat and ever-increasing challenges.

row.name: Night of the Living Skurre
row.detailed_description: Night of the Living Skurre is a 3D, third person action-platformer, where the player plays as Skurre, a squirrel, who has to save their forest by driving lumberjacks insane with pranks and traps. Skurre has to use every ability in their disposal: climb and jump around, throw pinecones, set up more elaborate traps or just place a banana peel on the ground, can you evade the lumberjacks grasp long enough to destroy their will to work? Use the environment to your advantage to hide and evade detection, lurk in the shadows and set up hidden traps that the lumberjack will unwittingly fall in to, be careful to not make too much noise! Explore the cabin and find hidden passages, wonderful opportunities and tools to help you in your task. Get chased by the lumberjack, lure them in to traps and outsmart them by causing noise and dropping stuff on their head. Make sure to not get caught, even a quick witted Skurre can be caught off guard by underestimating humans!
row.short_description: A 3D, third person action-platformer. Explore and set up various pranks. Hide and avoid detection, get chased under the couch, watch and laugh as people trip down the stairs, throw pinecones to annoy someone until they snap in this comedic game about a squirrel protecting their home!

row.name: 飘渺之路 Path to the Void Playtest
Wildheart Gourmet
row.detailed_description: An Encouraging Warning! This game is based on real facts and techniques for wild food identification and preparation. If the idea of being able to find your own food the way our ancestors did interests you at all, I strongly encourage you to go out and try it yourself. However, this project is a starting point and not a comprehensive guide ; please consult a resource specific to your area in order to harvest safely & responsibly! About the Game Wildheart Gourmet is an interactive fiction cook-em-up about foraging wild foods and finding our place in the natural world. For as long as your tribe's oral history records, people have lived within the idyllic world known as the Echo, thriving off of the land's generous bounty. But as inhospitable desert begins to spread across the world, you must venture out on a quest for truths rumored to explain the crisis. In Wildheart Gourmet, get ready to: Explore locations across the Echo to collect clues about its true nature Every location reveals a piece of an eon-spanning puzzle, revealing a mystery with world-shattering consequences! Meet people and learn about their way of life Encounter the people of the Echo and discover their lives, beliefs and foodways in your search! Live off the land by foraging edible plants and useful herbs Using real knowledge of wild edible plants and herbs, survive and thrive on your journey by foraging! Develop your mastery of medicinal herbs by helping those in need with the right remedy for each complaint. Featuring a bespoke score by musician and audio specialist Shelly Ferina as well as guest artwork from interdisciplinary designer Anna Zimmer! The goal of this game is to introduce people to the concept of foraging wild foods, highlighting invasive species that are underappreciated as edibles and encouraging harmony with our natural world. Foraging is a highly local discipline, so I have limited the ecological focus of this experience to temperate North America.
row.short_description: Unlock the mysteries of a strange yet familiar world and forage real wild plants & herbs in this curious, peaceful adventure! An experimental interactive fiction cook-em-up with educational elements.

row.name: My Silly Science Summer in the Past
row.detailed_description: A cozy, time-traveling visual novel about friendship, curiosity, and weird science mishaps. Take a trip back in time for the silliest, smartest summer you’ve ever had! In My Silly Science Summer in the Past , you play as a curious and clever girl who stumbles into a strange experiment—and finds herself transported to the past! But don’t worry, you're not alone. Join a lovable crew of eccentric science girls: energetic Azuki , brilliant Marie , bold Patti , and mysterious Sylvia . Together, you’ll explore bizarre inventions, solve quirky puzzles, and maybe accidentally explode a few things (for science!). Experience the power of new friendships, collaboration, and scientific wonder. 🧪 Features: 🌸 A heartwarming story about friendship and science 🕰️ Time-travel shenanigans with just a pinch of chaos 💬 Fully illustrated characters and charming dialogue 🎨 Cool art style with cozy vibes 👩‍🔬 Four unique girls to bond with—no romance, just real friendship 🔬 A sweet narrative perfect in length for a relaxed weekend Whether you love science, stories about friendship, or just a good laugh, My Silly Science Summer in the Past is your ticket to an unforgettable, geeky adventure. 👧 Meet the girls! 👩‍🦰 Azuki – The friendly girl with beautiful pink hair from the astronomy class that often starts telling scifi stories as if they were real. Is she just a bit weird or what's her deal? Marie – The young girl from the country side. A math genius that seems to be awfully shy. Maybe she will become more talkative once she knows you better? Patti – The cool physics girl. Experiments are her life, and wherever she does them she leaves a trail of fire and explosions behind. Her energy level is insane, but she would do anything for her friends. Sylvia – 'Baroness Sylvia von Tensberg', to be precise. Yes, a real noble woman, and totally not interested in science. She prefers arts. Why is she at the science camp then? Well, try to solve her mystery, but watch out for her sharp tongue! 🧁 Sweet Science Parts of the game follow the story of our other visual novel 'Sweet Science' . This time, however, you are a girl who ends up at the mysterious science camp in the past. (If you prefer to play as a boy, try out 'Sweet Science' instead.)
row.short_description: A visual novel for girls: Experience a fun time travel adventure and make friends with some quirky girls at a science camp. Will you solve the mysteries and find your way back to your time? Your choices make your own story! Full with challenging puzzle games, and unique endings.

row.name: Legend Of The Platforms
row.detailed_description: The player starts off on Earth and has the choice to draw cards to move on Earth or move down a platform to enter the Underworld. On Earth, there is a trainer that can teach you how to kill the enemy on Earth in exchange for currency. You have to land on the Earth enemy first once you are trained to kill the Earth enemy. There is a rare gem in the underworld that can be found and brought to the blacksmith on Earth. The black smith can forge a blade out of the rare gem in exchange for currency. The blade forged from the rare gem by the black smith can kill any enemy on the board, supernatural or on Earth, if you land on the enemy first. Bring the blade forged from the underworld gem to the guardian angels in heaven to become the most powerful on the board, being able to kill any enemy in any situation, winning the game. The player also has a side quest to save a man’s wife who is locked up in the underworld in exchange for Earth currency. Aquire heaven currency to bribe the Underworld guard to avoid losing the game when the underworld guard lands on your position. Be careful with acquiring heaven currency. If the Earth enemy finds out about heaven currency, it will become greedy and head to the heavens. When the heaven guard finds out that heaven currency is being distributed on Earth, it will come find you on all three platforms. If the heaven guard finds out that the underworld guard has heaven currency, it will kill the underworld guard, a good tactic to know. Special thanks to Steven Seleb for permission to use his tunes for the soundtrack. Special thanks to Mark Jiannino for a track as well.
row.short_description: Fan of chess? Looking for an otherworldly challenge? From the creator of “Diamond Board” gives you “Legend Of The Platforms”, a casual but intricate game you can play in one sitting. Deal with supernatural and ordinary enemies, forge a blade from a rare gem in the underworld, and dominate the board.
row.notes: The game includes a rare gem in the underworld that can kill any of the supernatural enemies in the game, which can be considered drug related content. Running into the heaven guard to where you fall back to Earth, and falling to your death after entering heaven again after drawing cards that make you fall due to the Heaven guards lack of forgiveness could be viewed as accidental death.

row.name: Make Tracks Great Again
row.detailed_description: Make Tracks Great Again： This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again. There is only one goal: make money, make money, make money. You need to earn more each time. How to make money?: Dispatch a train of the corresponding color to the platform based on the cargo color of the truck, wait until the train is fully loaded and departs. You'll earn a huge sum once the train leaves. If: No train matching the cargo color is available at the platform, the truck will leave with the cargo, resulting in a massive fine. —————————————————————————————————————————————— Once, this railway station stood as the greatest, most profitable, and most incredible transportation hub in the nation—without equal! For decades it operated in glorious efficiency, with cities daily vying to pack our freight cars to the brim. The volume of orders back then was so overwhelming that the rails nearly buckled under the strain! Then one day—no one understood why—certain individuals began destroying it all with catastrophically poor decisions! Now? Our debts now outnumber the bolts on these rails, and liquidation agents are smirking on the platforms, calculators in hand! How Many Steps to Fit an Elephant into a Refrigerator? No.1:Lift the barrier gate to allow the truck access to the station No.2:Select a train matching the cargo’s color No.3:Wait for the cargo to be loaded No.4:Wait for the train to be fully loaded and depart the station Simple, right? Tasks required: Select trains matching the cargo’s color, allocate trains on the tracks appropriately, control the opening and closing of barrier gates, and manage trucks entering the station.     BUT!!!      Trucks departing with cargo will cause significant losses to the station!!!           Hold on： 'Listen up, rookie. You’re the new acting stationmaster now, and this is an ‘absolutely simple’ job! Use your astonishing talents to make tracks great again! (Trust me, everyone who’s ever believed in me calls this the greatest slogan in history.) Before you, 73 acting agents briefly restored the station to glory—for about five minutes. And then? This place ended up buried under new debt! Guess what happened to those losers? Oh, and right now, dozens of self-proclaimed ‘genius’ agents are working in other offices, competing against you in real time. So, which of you will prove to be the top agent?' — Boss
row.short_description: This is a simulation management game about how to Make Tracks Great Again: Only by ensuring trains depart the platform fully loaded with correct cargo can you earn more money and restore the station's greatness.
